292	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
293	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
294	- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。
295	
296	### Things3 只读边界
297	
298	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
299	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
315	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
316	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
317	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
318	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。

263	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
264	
265	### Git / 分支
266	
267	- 当前用户要求直接在 `main` 开发；不要重新创建嵌套 worktree，也不要切回旧实现 worktree进行新开发。
268	- 不要对 `main` 做 `reset --hard`、force push、rebase、amend 或删除提交。
269	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或 `git commit`（不带明确路径）。功能提交必须显式列出文件，并使用 `git commit --only`。
270	- 当前 `d4a17d7` 已在 `origin/main` 记录中，先检查其来源和内容，不要假设它只是普通 Task 3 提交。
271	- 不要把用户已有的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store` 或其他无关暂存/未跟踪状态带入后续功能提交。
272	- 提交前用 `git status --short`、`git diff --cached --name-status`、`git show --name-status HEAD` 验证边界。
273	
274	### Worktree / SDD
275	
276	- 不要删除 `.claude/worktrees/*` 或 `.superpowers/sdd/*`；它们是恢复和审查材料。
277	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`。
278	- 不要因为历史提交看起来重复，就擅自 squash 或重写历史。
279	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当作 review BASE；BASE 必须是 implementer dispatch 之前记录的实际提交。
280	- 不要把 implementer 自测当作 task review；规格合规和代码质量两个 verdict 都必须存在。
281	- 不要在 controller 中直接修 reviewer finding；必须恢复原 implementer（前 3 轮）或在第 4–5 轮换更强的新 agent。
282	- 每轮 fix 必须有 covering tests、命令和结果，然后才能 scoped re-review。
283	
284	### Things3 只读边界
285	
286	- 不要直接读取/写入 Things SQLite；业务代码只能通过窄 API 读取。
287	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper，不要构造 `update` 或 `update-project` URL。
288	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
289	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled；状态和 trashed 是两个维度。
290	- 不要输出 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
291	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义，不能只用 `start` 字段重建。
292	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
293	
294	### 文件与路径安全
295	
296	- 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
297	- 后续写文件必须同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时原文件保留。
298	- 已存在但没有生成 marker 的文件不能覆盖；预检阶段要在任何写入前失败。
299	- 只能删除 manifest/marker 明确托管的文件；陌生文件必须保留并记录 warning。
300	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于下一轮当前文件删除集合。
301	- 所有相对路径都要拒绝绝对路径、`..` 和仓库外解析结果。
302	- Python 最低版本为 3.9：避免 `X | None`、`list[str]` 等仅在 3.10+ 可用的写法，优先 `Optional`、`List`、`Tuple`、`Dict`。
303	
304	### Git 同步实现
305	
306	- 生产同步不能使用真实 index 暂存 managed 文件；必须使用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`。
307	- 临时 index 提交成功后，只用 `git reset -q HEAD -- <managed paths>` 刷新真实 index，保留用户无关暂存。
308	- Git 提交失败后，文件可能已经落盘；下一轮仍须依据 manifest 的历史 managed pathspec 检查并恢复提交。
309	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或解决冲突。
310	- 只用 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 记录同步器创建但未推送的提交；不要因为分支一般性领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
311	- Git 命令必须通过带 timeout、捕获 stderr 的 `subprocess.run()`；日志中的 URL userinfo、token、auth-token、password 必须脱敏。
312	- 不要 push 到真实远端、不要加载 launchd、不要修改系统配置，除非用户另行明确要求。
313

   129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
   130	                    self._pending = False
   131	                    self._schedule_locked()
   132	                self._condition.notify_all()
   133	
   134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
   135	        with self._condition:
   136	            if self._stopped:
   137	                running = self._running
   138	            else:
   139	                self._stopped = True
   140	                self._pending = False
   141	                self._generation += 1
   142	                timer = self._timer
   143	                self._timer = None
   144	                if timer is not None:
   145	                    timer.cancel()
   146	                running = self._running
   147	
   148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
   149	            with self._condition:
   150	                while self._running:
   151	                    self._condition.wait()

   154	class DatabaseWatcher:
   155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
   156	
   157	    def __init__(
   158	        self,
   159	        database_path: Path,
   160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
   161	        observer_factory=Observer,
   162	    ) -> None:
   163	        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
   164	        self._debounce = debounce
   165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
   166	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
   167	        self._observer = None
   168	        self._started = False
   169	        self._starting = False
   170	        self._stopping = False
   171	        self._stop_requested = False
   172	
   173	    @staticmethod
   174	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
   175	        try:
   176	            observer.stop()
   177	        except Exception:
   178	            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
   179	        try:
   180	            observer.join(timeout=10)
   181	        except Exception:
   182	            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
   183	
   184	    def start(self) -> None:
   185	        parent = self._database_path.parent
   186	        if not parent.is_dir():
   187	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
   188	
   189	        with self._condition:
   190	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
   191	                self._condition.wait()
   192	            if self._started:
   193	                return
   194	            self._starting = True
   195	            self._stop_requested = False
   196	
   197	        observer = None
   198	        try:
   199	            observer = self._observer_factory()
   200	            with self._condition:
   201	                self._observer = observer
   202	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
   203	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
   204	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
   205	            observer.start()
   206	        except Exception:
   207	            if observer is not None:
   208	                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
   209	            with self._condition:
   210	                if self._observer is observer:
   211	                    self._observer = None
   212	                self._started = False
   213	                self._starting = False
   214	                self._stop_requested = False
   215	                self._condition.notify_all()
   216	            raise
   217	
   218	        with self._condition:
   219	            self._started = True
   220	            self._starting = False
   221	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
   222	            self._condition.notify_all()
   223	
   224	        if stop_requested:
   225	            self.stop()
   226	
   227	    def stop(self) -> None:
   228	        with self._condition:
   229	            if self._starting:
   230	                self._stop_requested = True
   231	                while self._starting:
   232	                    self._condition.wait()
   233	            while self._stopping:
   234	                self._condition.wait()
   235	                if not self._started:
   236	                    return
   237	            if not self._started:
   238	                return
   239	            observer = self._observer
   240	            self._stopping = True
   241	
   242	        errors = []
   243	        try:
   244	            try:
   245	                observer.stop()
   246	            except Exception as exc:
   247	                errors.append(exc)
   248	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
   249	            try:
   250	                observer.join(timeout=10)
   251	            except Exception as exc:
   252	                errors.append(exc)
   253	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
   254	
   255	            alive = False
   256	            try:
   257	                alive = observer.is_alive()
   258	            except Exception as exc:
   259	                errors.append(exc)
   260	                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
   261	            if alive:
   262	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
   263	        finally:
   264	            with self._condition:
   265	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
   266	                if cleanup_succeeded:
   267	                    self._started = False
   268	                    self._observer = None
   269	                    self._stop_requested = False
   270	                self._stopping = False
   271	                self._condition.notify_all()
   272	
   273	        if errors:
   274	            raise errors[0]
```

22	
23	def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
24	    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
25	
26	
27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51	
52	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,
58	            (
59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )
63	
64	
65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
167	        self._observer = None
168	        self._started = False
169	        self._starting = False
170	        self._stopping = False
171	        self._stop_requested = False
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
175	        try:
176	            observer.stop()
177	        except Exception:
178	            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
179	        try:
180	            observer.join(timeout=10)
181	        except Exception:
182	            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
183	
184	    def start(self) -> None:
185	        parent = self._database_path.parent
186	        if not parent.is_dir():
187	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
188	
189	        with self._condition:
190	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
191	                self._condition.wait()
192	            if self._started:
193	                return
194	            self._starting = True
195	            self._stop_requested = False
196	
197	        observer = None
198	        try:
199	            observer = self._observer_factory()
200	            with self._condition:
201	                self._observer = observer
202	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
203	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
204	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
205	            observer.start()
206	        except Exception:
207	            if observer is not None:
208	                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
209	            with self._condition:
210	                if self._observer is observer:
211	                    self._observer = None
212	                self._started = False
213	                self._starting = False
214	                self._stop_requested = False
215	                self._condition.notify_all()
216	            raise
217	
218	        with self._condition:
219	            self._started = True
220	            self._starting = False
221	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
222	            self._condition.notify_all()
223	
224	        if stop_requested:
225	            self.stop()
226	
227	    def stop(self) -> None:
228	        with self._condition:
229	            if self._starting:
230	                self._stop_requested = True
231	                while self._starting:
232	                    self._condition.wait()
233	            while self._stopping:
234	                self._condition.wait()
235	                if not self._started:
236	                    return
237	            if not self._started:
238	                return
239	            observer = self._observer
240	            self._stopping = True
241	
242	        errors = []
243	        try:
244	            try:
245	                observer.stop()
246	            except Exception as exc:
247	                errors.append(exc)
248	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
249	            try:
250	                observer.join(timeout=10)
251	            except Exception as exc:
252	                errors.append(exc)
253	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
254	
255	            alive = False
256	            try:
257	                alive = observer.is_alive()
258	            except Exception as exc:
259	                errors.append(exc)
260	                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
261	            if alive:
262	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
263	        finally:
264	            with self._condition:
265	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
266	                if cleanup_succeeded:
267	                    self._started = False
268	                    self._observer = None
269	                    self._stop_requested = False
270	                self._stopping = False
271	                self._condition.notify_all()
272	
273	        if errors:
274	            raise errors[0]
275	
```

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]

+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)

+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+

+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()

+class BlockingStartObserver(FakeObserver):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.start_entered = threading.Event()
+        self.release_start = threading.Event()
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.start_entered.set()
+        assert self.release_start.wait(2)
+        self.started = True
+
+
+def test_watcher_concurrent_starts_create_one_observer(tmp_path):
+    observer = BlockingStartObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=factory)
+    errors = []
+
+    first = threading.Thread(target=lambda: _call_and_record(watcher.start, errors))
+    second = threading.Thread(target=lambda: _call_and_record(watcher.start, errors))
+    first.start()
+    assert observer.start_entered.wait(1)
+    second.start()
+    assert second.is_alive()
+    observer.release_start.set()
+    first.join(1)
+    second.join(1)
+
+    assert not errors
+    assert not first.is_alive()
+    assert not second.is_alive()
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    watcher.stop()
+
+
+def test_watcher_start_racing_stop_waits_and_cleans_up(tmp_path):
+    observer = BlockingStartObserver()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+    start_errors = []
+    stop_finished = threading.Event()
+
+    starter = threading.Thread(target=lambda: _call_and_record(watcher.start, start_errors))
+    starter.start()
+    assert observer.start_entered.wait(1)
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (watcher.stop(), stop_finished.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stop_finished.wait(0.05)
+    observer.release_start.set()
+    starter.join(1)
+    stopper.join(1)
+
+    assert not start_errors
+    assert stop_finished.is_set()
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    watcher.stop()
+
+
+def _call_and_record(function, errors):
+    try:
+        function()
+    except Exception as error:
+        errors.append(error)
+
+

44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
142	
```

1	"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	from pathlib import Path
6	from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
7	
8	try:
9	    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
10	    from watchdog.observers import Observer
11	except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
12	    class FileSystemEventHandler:
13	        pass
14	
15	    class Observer:
16	        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
17	            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
18	
19	
20	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
21	
22	
23	def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
24	    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
25	
26	
27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51	
52	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,
58	            (
59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )
63	
64	
65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
204	
```

@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+

+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():

+    yield FakeTimer

+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):

+    debounce.notify()

+    assert third.delay == 2.0

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,

73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:

76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay

79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None

127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
204

241	- 使用完整未跟踪文件内容重新生成 Task 7 review package，不能只依赖 `git diff`，因为新文件尚未 tracked。
242	- 独立 review Git subprocess 边界、临时 index 隔离、路径规格、凭证脱敏、pending-push 状态机和真实临时仓库测试。
243	- 修复 findings 后复审，更新 SDD ledger。
244	
245	### 第二步：Task 7 边界检查和提交准备
246	
247	Task 7 review clean 后，分别检查各任务的未提交内容。由于 Task 4、Task 5/6、Task 7 都在当前 workspace，不能使用 `git add .`。
248	
249	计划提交前应：
250	
251	- 先确认用户是否希望现在创建功能提交；本会话之前明确要求实现代理不自行提交。
252	- 若提交，按任务拆分、显式列出路径并使用 `git commit --only`；不要把 `HANDOFF*`、nested worktree 条目、`.DS_Store`、`.gitignore` 或其他无关状态带入。
253	- 提交前检查 `git status --short`、`git diff --cached --name-status`、`git show --name-status HEAD`。
254	
255	### 第三步：Task 8 — Sync Engine Transaction Boundary
256	
257	按计划文件生成 brief 并记录新的 BASE，然后只新增：
258	
259	- `src/sync_engine.py`
260	- `tests/test_sync_engine.py`
261	
262	实现读取 -> render -> reconcile -> Git 的单一路径、进程内互斥锁、`sync_if_idle()` 非阻塞入口、失败边界和 `SyncResult`。完成后执行独立 spec/code-quality review。
263	
264	后续顺序：
265	
266	- Task 9：SQLite/WAL/SHM watcher、防抖、pending rerun。
267	- Task 10：service lifecycle、启动/周期同步、SIGINT/SIGTERM。
268	- Task 11：setup.py 和 launchd plist preview。
269	- Task 12：临时 Git 仓库端到端集成测试。
270	- Task 13：README 与 Agent.md 对齐。
271	- Task 14：compileall、全套测试、禁止操作扫描、whole-branch review。
272	
273	每个任务必须有 brief、记录 BASE、implementer report、review package 和独立双 verdict review。
274	
275	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
276	
277	### Git 和分支
278	
279	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
280	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
281	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
282	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
283	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
284	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
285	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
286	
287	### SDD 流程
288	
289	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
290	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
291	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
292	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
293	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
294	- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。
295	
296	### Things3 只读边界
297	
298	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
299	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
315	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
316	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
317	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
318	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
319	
```

150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md

205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215

217

118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
142

265	### Git / 分支

285	
286	- 不要直接读取/写入 Things SQLite；业务代码只能通过窄 API 读取。

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
