+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_watcher_requires_existing_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(
+        tmp_path / "missing" / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_rejects_regular_file_as_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
+    parent.write_text("not a directory")
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(parent / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory)
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails(tmp_path):
+    startup_error = RuntimeError("observer startup failed")
+    observer = Mock()
+    observer.start.side_effect = startup_error
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="observer startup failed") as raised:
+        watcher.start()
+
+    assert raised.value is startup_error
+    observer.stop.assert_called_once_with()
+    observer.join.assert_called_once_with(timeout=10)
+
+
+    observer = FakeObserver(alive=True)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+    watcher.start()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        watcher.stop()
+    assert "did not stop" in caplog.text

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):

26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:

38	        if not path:

56

58	        self._handle(

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154	
155	
156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
206	
```

51	        status["stage"] = "reader"

53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"

55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"

57	        status["changes"] = changes

59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(

61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:

100	                    status["stage"],

102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111

115	            "changes": None,

117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }

122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:

127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:

133	        self._lock.acquire()

165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189

@@ -0,0 +1,274 @@
+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]

+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()

150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,

```
1	# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP 设计
2	
3	## 背景
4	
5	本项目需要在 macOS 上只读监听 Things3 数据库，将任务导出为结构化 Markdown，并通过 Git 自动提交和推送到用户已配置的远端仓库。
6	
7	仓库中的 `Agent.md` 描述了完整产品愿景，但当前主项目尚无实现。内嵌的 `things.py` 1.0.1 参考库公开的是返回稀疏字典的函数接口，而不是 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 类；它也不提供优先级、Evening 等字段。因此 MVP 以参考库的真实只读数据为准，不输出无法可靠获得的字段。
8	
9	## 目标
10	
11	MVP 必须做到：
12	
13	1. 启动时读取完整 Things3 快照并同步 Markdown。
14	2. 监听 Things3 SQLite 数据库及其 WAL/SHM 变化，经防抖后再次同步。
15	3. 使用确定性渲染和原子文件替换，使内容未变化时不写磁盘、不产生 Git diff。
16	4. 自动暂存同步器实际变更的明确路径，按配置提交并推送。
17	5. 定时运行同一套完整快照同步，修复遗漏或漂移。
18	6. 捕获 `SIGINT` 和 `SIGTERM`，停止接收新工作并等待当前同步结束。
19	7. 提供安装、配置、前台运行与 launchd 部署文档和自动化测试。
20	
21	## 非目标
22	
23	MVP 不包括：
24	
25	- 从 Markdown 写回 Things3。
26	- Things 附件同步。
27	- 自动 merge、rebase 或解决 Git 冲突。
28	- 从底层数据库私有字段推导 `things.py` 未公开的优先级、Evening 或重复规则。
29	- Web 管理界面和性能监控面板。
30	- 对真实 GitHub 远端或真实用户 Things 数据库执行自动化集成测试。
31	
32	## 关键决策
33	
34	### 同步策略
35	
36	采用“防抖后的确定性完整快照”策略，而不是在 MVP 中维护独立的增量写入路径。
37	
38	每次同步均执行：
39	
40	```text
41	读取完整只读快照
42	  -> 规范化数据
43	  -> 渲染期望文件集合
44	  -> 原子协调磁盘
45	  -> 明确暂存变更路径
46	  -> 可选提交
47	  -> 可选推送
48	```
49	
50	SQLite 文件变化事件无法直接指出发生变化的任务。即使做 UUID 级增量更新，也必须先读取新快照做差异比较。完整快照渲染可同时正确处理任务移动、删除、容器重命名和 Today/Upcoming 派生视图，并让启动同步、监听同步和定时校验复用同一条代码路径。
51	
52	完整快照不意味着无条件重写文件。文件协调器先比较字节内容，只替换发生变化的文件。由此，单个标题变化通常只产生对应标题行的 Git diff。
53	
54	### 文件所有权
55	
56	同步器完全管理它生成的 Markdown 内容，但删除操作采用保守边界：
57	
58	- 每个生成文件包含稳定的生成标识。
59	- 仅删除位于已知导出路径中、带生成标识且不再属于期望快照的文件。
60	- 未带生成标识的陌生文件始终保留并记录警告。
61	- 同步器不使用笼统的目录递归删除处理未知内容。
62	
63	该规则兼顾确定性全量协调和用户文件保护。
64	
65	### 主位置与派生视图
66	
67	每个任务只有一个主位置，优先级如下：
68	
69	1. 所属 Project。
70	2. 所属 Area。
71	3. `Inbox`、`Anytime` 或 `Someday` 顶层列表。
72	
73	`Today.md` 和 `Upcoming.md` 是派生视图，允许重复展示已有主位置的任务。Today 的语义直接复用 `things.today()`，不根据单一 `start` 字段自行重建。
74	
75	## 架构
76	
77	### `src/config.py`
78	
79	负责读取和验证 `.env` 配置，向其他模块提供类型化配置对象。配置包括：
80	
81	- `REPO_PATH`：目标 Git 仓库绝对路径。
82	- `THINGSDB`：可选数据库覆盖路径；缺省时使用 `things.py` 自带的路径发现。
83	- `LOG_LEVEL`、`LOG_MAX_BYTES`、`LOG_BACKUP_COUNT`。
84	- `WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS`。
85	- `FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL`。
86	- `AUTO_COMMIT`、`AUTO_PUSH`。
87	- `GIT_REMOTE`、`GIT_BRANCH`。
88	- Git 子进程超时。
89	
90	约束：`AUTO_PUSH=true` 时必须启用 `AUTO_COMMIT`。目标路径必须存在且为 Git 工作树。敏感配置不写入日志。
91	
92	### `src/models.py`
93	
94	定义项目内部不可变数据模型，将外部稀疏字典与渲染逻辑隔离。主要实体为：
95	
96	- `TaskSnapshot`
97	- `ChecklistItem`
98	- `ContainerSnapshot`
99	- `ThingsSnapshot`
100	
101	可选字段有明确的 `None` 或空集合默认值。状态只接受 `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled`；类型只接受 MVP 用到的 `to-do`、`project`、`heading`。
102	
103	### `src/things_adapter.py`
104	
105	只使用 `things` 的读取接口：`tasks()`、`areas()`、`today()`、`upcoming()` 等，并把结果规范化为内部模型。
106	
107	该模块不导入或调用 `complete()`，也不构造 `update`/`update-project` URL。数据库访问失败后等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次。只有读取并规范化完整快照成功后才向调用方返回结果。
108	
109	数据库定位遵循：
110	
111	1. 显式 `THINGSDB`。
112	2. `things.py` 对现代 `ThingsData-*` 路径的发现。
113	3. 参考库的旧路径回退。
114	
115	### `src/renderer.py`
116	
117	输入一个 `ThingsSnapshot`，输出 `dict[Path, str]`，键是相对于目标仓库的安全路径，值是确定性 UTF-8 Markdown 内容。
118	
119	职责包括：
120	
121	- 分配任务主位置和终态文件。
122	- 构造 Today/Upcoming 派生视图。
123	- 对任务进行稳定排序。
124	- 渲染任务区块、UUID 注释、元数据和 checklist。
125	- 清理文件名并解决路径冲突。
126	- 转义会破坏 Markdown 结构的单行内容。
127	
128	该模块不读取或写入文件，也不执行 Git。
129	
130	### `src/filesystem.py`
131	
132	协调期望文件集合与目标仓库当前状态：
133	
134	- 内容相同的文件不写入。
135	- 新内容先写入目标文件同目录下的临时文件，刷新后使用 `os.replace()` 原子替换。
136	- 删除不再存在的旧托管文件。
137	- 保留所有陌生文件。
138	- 返回新增、修改、删除的明确相对路径集合，供 Git 层使用。
139	
140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`

166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
206

22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,

39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

18	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
19	_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s'\"<>]+")
20	_SECRET_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)\b(token|auth-token|password)=([^&#\s]+)")
21	_RENAME_OR_COPY = {"R", "C"}
22	_COMMIT_NO_DIFF = "no-diff"

27	@dataclass(frozen=True)
28	class ChangeCounts:
29	    added: int
30	    modified: int

34	def generate_commit_message(counts: ChangeCounts, now: datetime) -> str:
35	    """Build the stable message used for managed sync commits."""
36	    return "Update: {} | Added {}, Modified {}, Deleted {}".format(
37	        now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), counts.added, counts.modified, counts.deleted
38	    )
39	
40	
41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:
48	        return value
49	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))
50	
51	
52	def _redact_credentials(text: str) -> str:
53	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
54	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
55	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)
56	
57	
58	def _path_strings(paths: Sequence[Path]) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
59	    return tuple(sorted({Path(path).as_posix() for path in paths}))
60	
61	
62	def _counts_from_name_status(output: str) -> ChangeCounts:
63	    fields = output.split("\0")
64	    index = 0
65	    added = modified = deleted = 0
66	    while index < len(fields):
67	        status = fields[index]
68	        if not status:
69	            break
70	        index += 1
71	        code = status[0]
72	        if code in _RENAME_OR_COPY:
73	            index += 2
74	        else:
75	            index += 1
76	        if code == "A":
77	            added += 1
78	        elif code == "D":
79	            deleted += 1
80	        else:
81	            modified += 1
82	    return ChangeCounts(added, modified, deleted)

85	class GitClient:
86	    """Run narrowly scoped Git commands against one configured repository."""
87	
88	    def __init__(
89	        self,
90	        repo_path: Path,
91	        timeout: float = 30.0,
92	        runner: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess] = subprocess.run,
93	    ) -> None:
94	        self.repo_path = Path(repo_path)
95	        self.timeout = timeout
96	        self.runner = runner
97	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
98	
99	    def _run(
100	        self, args: Sequence[str], env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None
101	    ) -> Optional[subprocess.CompletedProcess]:
102	        command = ["git"] + list(args)
103	        kwargs = {
104	            "cwd": self.repo_path,
105	            "capture_output": True,
106	            "text": True,
107	            "timeout": self.timeout,
108	            "check": False,
109	        }
110	        if env is not None:
111	            command_env = os.environ.copy()
112	            command_env.update(env)
113	            kwargs["env"] = command_env
114	        try:
115	            result = self.runner(command, **kwargs)
116	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
117	            _LOG.error("Git command timed out: %s", _redact_credentials(" ".join(command)))
118	            return None
119	        except OSError as error:
120	            _LOG.error("Git command failed to start: %s (%s)", _redact_credentials(" ".join(command)), _redact_credentials(str(error)))
121	            return None
122	        if result.returncode != 0 and not (
123	            args[:3] == ["diff", "--cached", "--quiet"] and result.returncode == 1
124	        ) and not (
125	            args[:3] == ["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet"] and result.returncode == 1
126	        ):
127	            _LOG.error(
128	                "Git command failed (%s): %s",
129	                _redact_credentials(" ".join(command)),
130	                _redact_credentials(result.stderr or ""),
131	            )
132	        return result
133	
134	    def stage(self, paths: Sequence[Path], *, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> bool:
135	        """Stage only the supplied paths and report whether they have a staged diff."""
136	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
137	        if not pathspecs:
138	            return False
139	        staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
140	        if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
141	            return False
142	        diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
143	        if diff is None:
144	            return False
145	        if diff.returncode == 1:
146	            return True
147	        if diff.returncode == 0:
148	            return False
149	        return False
150	
151	    def _isolated_commit(self, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime]) -> bool:
152	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_FAILURE
153	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
154	        if not pathspecs:
155	            self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
156	            return False
157	        try:
158	            descriptor, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="things3-sync-index-")
159	        except OSError as error:
160	            _LOG.error("Could not initialize temporary Git index: %s", error)
161	            return False
162	        os.close(descriptor)
163	        index_path = Path(index_name)
164	        try:
165	            index_path.unlink()
166	            index_env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
167	            seeded = self._run(["read-tree", "HEAD"], index_env)
168	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:
169	                return False
170	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
174	            if diff is None:
175	                return False
176	            if diff.returncode == 0:
177	                self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
178	                return False
179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
```

+class FakeTimer:

+

CONFIRMED

Concrete trigger: `Observer.start()` starts its worker thread and then raises, or `stop()` plus `join(timeout=10)` returns while that worker remains alive. Startup cleanup only calls:

> “observer.stop()”  
> “observer.join(timeout=10)”

at lines 175-182, then unconditionally executes:

> “self._observer = None”  
> “self._started = False”  
> “self._starting = False”

at lines 209-215. A subsequent `start()` passes the `if self._started` check at line 192 and creates another observer at line 199, leaving the original live observer able to emit events.

Task 9 lines 1745-1747 require:

> “stop() calls `observer.stop()` then `observer.join(timeout=10)`; if still alive, log an error.”

The regular `stop()` path checks `observer.is_alive()` and preserves state, but startup-failure cleanup does not. The focused tests could not run because `pytest` is not installed.

result: Confirmed a startup cleanup lifecycle bug that can create a second observer while the failed observer thread remains alive.

340	Every snapshot `__post_init__` must normalize externally supplied lists to tuples. `RenderedSnapshot` must copy `files` and wrap that copy in `MappingProxyType`; a frozen dataclass alone does not prevent a caller from mutating a supplied dict. `ThingsSnapshot` rejects duplicate container UUIDs across projects and areas as well as duplicate task UUIDs. `ChangeSet.__post_init__` must normalize all explicit path sequences to sorted unique tuples and derive `git_paths` from `paths` only when no historical pathspec was supplied.

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

7-仓库中的 `Agent.md` 描述了完整产品愿景，但当前主项目尚无实现。内嵌的 `things.py` 1.0.1 参考库公开的是返回稀疏字典的函数接口，而不是 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 类；它也不提供优先级、Evening 等字段。因此 MVP 以参考库的真实只读数据为准，不输出无法可靠获得的字段。

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.exists():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
