        :type event:
            :class:`DirMovedEvent` or :class:`FileMovedEvent`

    def on_created(self, event: DirCreatedEvent | FileCreatedEvent) -> None:

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()

35	            database,

37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),

40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
142

```
"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""

import logging
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple

from .filesystem import reconcile
from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
from .renderer import render_snapshot


_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
        ...


class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
    def sync(
        self,
        changes: ChangeSet,
        auto_commit: bool,
        auto_push: bool,
        remote: str,
        branch: str,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
        ...


class SyncEngine:
    def __init__(
        self,
        config,
        reader: SnapshotReader,
        git_client: GitSyncClient,
        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.reader = reader
        self.git_client = git_client
        self.renderer = renderer
        self.reconciler = reconciler
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
        status["stage"] = "reader"
        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
        status["stage"] = "renderer"
        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
        status["changes"] = changes
        status["stage"] = "git"
        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
            changes,
            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
            remote=self.config.git_remote,
            branch=self.config.git_branch,
        )
        status["committed"] = committed
        status["pushed"] = pushed
        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)

    @staticmethod
    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
        try:
            changes = status["changes"]
            counts = (
                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                if changes is not None
                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
            )
            committed = status["committed"]
            pushed = status["pushed"]
            if committed is None:
                committed = "not executed"
            if pushed is None:
                pushed = "not executed"
            duration = time.monotonic() - started
            error = status["error"]
            if error is None:
                _LOG.info(
                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                )
            else:
                _LOG.error(
                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
                    status["stage"],
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                    error,
                )
        except BaseException:
            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
            pass

    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
        status = {
            "stage": "reader",
            "changes": None,
            "committed": None,
            "pushed": None,
            "error": None,
        }
        try:
            return self._sync_locked(status)
        except BaseException as error:
            status["error"] = error
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                self._log_sync(started, status)
            finally:
                self._lock.release()

    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
        started = time.monotonic()
        self._lock.acquire()
        return self._run_locked(started)

    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
        started = time.monotonic()
        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return False
        self._run_locked(started)
        return True
```

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""

30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:

61	            ),

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152

154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()

157	    def __init__(
158	        self,

175	        observer = self._observer_factory()

184	            except Exception:

186	            try:

188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise

200	        observer.stop()

1721	Implement a `FakeTimer` in the test that records `start`, `cancel`, and exposes `fire()`. Tests must prove:
1722	
1723	- Three `notify()` calls before fire cancel prior timers and invoke request once.
1724	- A notification while `request()` is executing sets a pending flag; after request returns, exactly one new timer is scheduled.
1725	- If `request()` returns false because the engine is busy, exactly one retry timer is scheduled.
1726	- `stop()` cancels the timer, rejects later notifications, and optionally joins an executing worker.
1727	- Delay must be positive.

1737	- [ ] **Step 4: Implement event filter and thread-safe debounce state machine**
1738	
1739	Subclass `watchdog.events.FileSystemEventHandler`. Compare resolved/normalized string paths for the database, `database.name + "-wal"`, and `database.name + "-shm"`. Never read database content in an event callback.
1740	
1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.
1742	
1743	Use daemon timers, but `stop(wait=True)` must wait on the condition until `_running` becomes false. Do not hold the condition while executing the sync callback.

1746	
1747	`DatabaseWatcher.start()` verifies `database_path.parent` exists, schedules one non-recursive watch on that parent, and starts the observer. `stop()` calls `observer.stop()` then `observer.join(timeout=10)`; if still alive, log an error. Starting twice or stopping before start is idempotent.

98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

+import threading
+from pathlib import Path

+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):

+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)

+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)

+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.

+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()

+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):

129	
130	- `auto_commit is False`: return `(False, False)` without staging or push.
131	- `changes.git_paths` is empty: skip staging and commit checks. If `auto_push` is enabled, retry push only when `git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/things3-sync/pending-push` returns success.
132	- `changes.paths` may be empty while `changes.git_paths` is nonempty; still inspect and commit those managed paths to recover from a prior failed commit.
133	- After a successful isolated commit, set `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` to `HEAD` with `git update-ref` before reporting `committed=True`. If marking fails, return `(False, False)` and do not push because durable retry state was not established.
134	- `auto_push is False`: retain the pending ref and return `(committed, False)`. This records that a later run with push enabled may publish the sync commit.
135	- With `auto_push=True`, push after a new marked commit or when the pending ref already exists. Do not infer pending work from the branch's general ahead/behind state.
136	- Push command is exactly `git push <remote> <branch>` in the real repository environment.
137	- After push succeeds, delete the ref with `git update-ref -d refs/things3-sync/pending-push`; if ref deletion fails, log it and return `pushed=False` so the next run safely retries an idempotent push.
138	- Push success after a commit created in this invocation returns `(True, True)`; push failure after that commit returns `(True, False)`.
139	- A retry-only push with no new commit returns `(False, True)` on success and `(False, False)` on failure. These booleans always describe actions completed in the current invocation.
140	
141	No Git operation raises for expected command errors; methods return false and log stderr. Invalid `auto_push=True, auto_commit=False` raises `ValueError` as a defensive invariant even though configuration already rejects it.

38	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
39	    value = match.group(0)
40	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
41	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
42	        return value
43	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
44	    if not userinfo:

46	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))

50	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
51	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
52	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

73	        if code == "A":
74	            added += 1
75	        elif code == "D":
76	            deleted += 1
77	        else:
78	            modified += 1
79	    return ChangeCounts(added, modified, deleted)

149	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
150	        if not pathspecs:

152	        descriptor, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="things3-sync-index-")
153	        os.close(descriptor)
154	        index_path = Path(index_name)
155	        try:

159	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:

161	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
162	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
163	                return False
164	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
165	            if diff is None or diff.returncode == 0:
166	                return False
167	            if diff.returncode != 1:
168	                return False
169	            self._commit_found_diff = True
170	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
174	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
175	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
176	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:

178	        finally:

222	        remote: str,

226	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
227	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
228	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
229	        if not auto_commit:
230	            return (False, False)

233	        committed = False
234	        pending = False
235	        if paths:

237	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)

242	                    return (False, False)

1. **src/git_ops.py:139** — `stage()` 将 `env` 传给 `git add`，但其 `diff --cached --quiet` 检查在第 139 行忽略了 `env`。在 `GIT_INDEX_FILE` 覆盖下，这会静默读取错误的索引。`_isolated_commit`（第 164 行）正确传递了 `env`，因此事务路径是安全的；仅 `stage()` 存在此问题。
2. **src/git_ops.py:238-239** — `sync()` 通过 `self._commit_found_diff` 和 `committed` 两个不同信号来跟踪提交结果。`_isolated_commit` 在找到差异时设置 `_commit_found_diff=True`，但若 `read-tree`/`add`/`diff`/`name-status`/`commit` 任一失败则提前返回 `False` 且不设置该标志。第 238 行的 `if self._commit_found_diff and not committed` 是死代码（`committed` 为 False 时 `_commit_found_diff` 不可能为 True），而第 240 行的 `if committed` 才是真正承载语义的地方。无害，但冗余且容易误读。
3. **无失败模式测试** — 规范要求的失败语义（标记失败、删除失败、刷新失败）没有测试用例。我已通过临时脚本验证；这些路径未被套件覆盖。
4. **src/git_ops.py:174** — `now or datetime.now()` 在 `now=None` 时回退到本地时间的 `datetime.now()`，导致提交消息时间戳不可变且依赖测试环境。规范允许 `now=None`，但没有测试固定该回退值；`test_commit_message_has_exact_counts_and_time` 传入了显式的 `now`。

### 未发现的问题

- 未发现环境变量覆盖被泄露到日志中的情况（`env` 仅作为 `kwargs["env"]` 传入，从不格式化）。
- 未发现 `subprocess.run` 的 `shell=True` 或未转义的路径用法。
- 未发现 `PENDING_PUSH_REF` 的拼写不一致；所有引用均使用模块常量。
- 未发现 `git_paths` 为空时的重试路径出现误判：`pending_push()` 仅检查 ref（src/git_ops.py:199-207），不检查 ahead/behind 状态。

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154

**Audit findings**

1. **Stale callback after timer replacement**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:113`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:113); existing coverage begins at [`tests/test_watcher.py:92`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/tests/test_watcher.py:92).
   - **Summary:** No test invokes an already-canceled timer after a newer timer has been scheduled.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** A real `threading.Timer` callback can race with `cancel()`. The generation check must reject the stale callback without clearing or replacing the current timer. A regression could execute duplicate syncs or corrupt the active timer state.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Add a test that fires the first canceled fake timer after the second notification, verifies no request occurs, then fires the current timer.

2. **Stale callback after `DebouncedSync.stop()`**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:136`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:136); existing stop coverage is at [`tests/test_watcher.py:159`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/tests/test_watcher.py:159).
   - **Summary:** The test verifies cancellation but never invokes the canceled timer callback after shutdown.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** Cancellation is not a guarantee that a callback already dequeued by the scheduler will not run. The callback must return because `_stopped` or the generation is invalid. Otherwise a sync can start after shutdown, causing database/Git activity during teardown or a newly scheduled timer.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Fire the pending timer after `stop()` and assert the request is not called and no timer is created.

3. **Stopping from the callback thread**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:148`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:148).
   - **Summary:** Existing coverage stops the debouncer from a separate thread, but does not test `stop(wait=True)` invoked by the active request callback.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** The current-thread exemption prevents the callback from waiting on itself. A regression would deadlock the timer thread. The test should also verify that the callback’s `finally` block does not schedule another timer after self-stop.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Have `request()` call `debounce.stop()` and assert the callback returns and no retry timer exists.

4. **Timer creation/start failure cleanup**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:93`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:93) and [`src/watcher.py:129`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:129).
   - **Summary:** No test covers a timer factory, daemon assignment, or `timer.start()` raising during initial scheduling or retry scheduling.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** `_timer` is assigned before `start()`. A failed start can leave a stale timer handle, produce an uncaught timer-thread exception, or leave a partially started timer resource behind. The debouncer’s ability to stop cleanly and recover on a later notification is unverified.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Use a fake timer that raises from `start()`, assert the failure behavior, cleanup/cancellation, and subsequent `stop()` or `notify()` behavior.

5. **Observer scheduling failure cleanup**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:175`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:175); the current startup-failure test is [`tests/test_watcher.py:270`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/tests/test_watcher.py:270).
   - **Summary:** Cleanup is tested when `observer.start()` fails, but `observer.schedule()` runs outside that cleanup block.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** If scheduling raises after the observer has allocated watches or other resources, `stop()` and `join()` are skipped. This can leak observer resources and leave later startup behavior ambiguous.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Make `schedule()` raise and assert the observer is cleaned up, the original exception propagates, and the watcher remains restartable or definitively stopped.

6. **Concurrent `DatabaseWatcher.start()` and `stop()`**
   - **File/line:** [`src/watcher.py:171`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:171) and [`src/watcher.py:196`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:196).
   - **Summary:** Lifecycle idempotence is tested only sequentially; `_started` and `_observer` are not synchronized.
   - **Failure scenario/cost:** Two concurrent `start()` calls can both pass the flag check and create observers, with one overwriting the other. A concurrent `stop()` can observe `_started == False` while startup is in progress and return, leaving an active observer that is never stopped.
   - **Actionable:** Yes. Use barriers/blocking fakes to race start/start and start/stop, then assert at most one observer remains and every created observer receives the required cleanup calls.

140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219

41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:

49	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))

53	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
54	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
55	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

276	
277	### Git 和分支
278	
279	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
280	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。

282	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
283	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。

287	### SDD 流程
288	
289	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
290	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
291	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
292	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
293	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
294	- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。
295	
296	### Things3 只读边界
297	
298	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
299	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
315	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
316	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
317	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
318	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
319	
320	### Git 实现
321	
322	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
323	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
324	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
325	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
326	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
327	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。

339	- 测试时避免产生不必要的 bytecode/cache；可用 `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider ...`。

22	
23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
24	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
25	
26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync
30	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
31	            database,
32	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
33	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
34	        }
35	
36	    @staticmethod
37	    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
38	        if not path:
39	            return None
40	        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
41	
42	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
43	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
44	            return
45	        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
46	            self._request_sync()
47	
48	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
49	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
50	
51	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
52	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
53	
54	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
55	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
56	
57	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
58	        self._handle(
59	            event,
60	            (
61	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
62	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
63	            ),
64	        )
65	
66	
67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154	
155	
156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
206

207	        attempts: int = 3,

214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay

217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,

226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)

232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)

41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:
48	        return value

126	        ):
127	            _LOG.error(
128	                "Git command failed (%s): %s",
129	                _redact_credentials(" ".join(command)),
130	                _redact_credentials(result.stderr or ""),
131	            )
132	        return result
133	
134	    def stage(self, paths: Sequence[Path], *, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> bool:
135	        """Stage only the supplied paths and report whether they have a staged diff."""
136	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
137	        if not pathspecs:
138	            return False
139	        staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
140	        if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
141	            return False
142	        diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), env)
143	        if diff is None:
144	            return False
145	        if diff.returncode == 1:
146	            return True
147	        if diff.returncode == 0:
148	            return False
149	        return False
150	
151	    def _isolated_commit(self, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime]) -> bool:
152	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_FAILURE
153	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
154	        if not pathspecs:
155	            self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
156	            return False
157	        try:
158	            descriptor, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="things3-sync-index-")
159	        except OSError as error:
160	            _LOG.error("Could not initialize temporary Git index: %s", error)
161	            return False
162	        os.close(descriptor)
163	        index_path = Path(index_name)
164	        try:
165	            index_path.unlink()
166	            index_env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
167	            seeded = self._run(["read-tree", "HEAD"], index_env)
168	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:
169	                return False
170	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
174	            if diff is None:
175	                return False
176	            if diff.returncode == 0:
177	                self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
178	                return False
179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)
265

3	import logging
4	from pathlib import Path
5	from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Sequence, Set, Tuple
6	
7	from .markdown import render_document
8	from .models import ContainerPath, ContainerSnapshot, RenderedSnapshot, TaskSnapshot, ThingsSnapshot
9	from .utils import sanitize_path_segment
10	
11	
12	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
13	_ROOT_FILES = (
14	    (Path("Inbox.md"), "Inbox"),
15	    (Path("Today.md"), "Today"),
16	    (Path("Anytime.md"), "Anytime"),
17	    (Path("Someday.md"), "Someday"),
18	    (Path("Upcoming.md"), "Upcoming"),
19	    (Path("已完成.md"), "已完成"),
20	    (Path("已取消.md"), "已取消"),
21	)
22	_CONTAINER_FILES = (
23	    ("tasks.md", "任务"),
24	    ("已完成.md", "已完成"),
25	    ("已取消.md", "已取消"),
26	)
27	_VALID_STARTS = {"Inbox", "Anytime", "Someday"}
28	_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH = 120
29	
30	
31	def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
32	    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)
33	
34	
35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:
42	            token.extend("x{:02x}".format(byte) for byte in character.encode("utf-8"))
43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"
44	
45	
46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
54	
55	
56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85	
86	
87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106
