108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171	
172	
173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
180	
181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected
233	
234	
235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266

28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51	
52	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,
58	            (
59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )

64	
65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
167	        self._observer = None
168	        self._started = False
169	        self._starting = False
170	        self._stopping = False
171	        self._stop_requested = False
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
175	        try:
176	            observer.stop()
177	        except Exception:
178	            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
179	        try:
180	            observer.join(timeout=10)
181	        except Exception:
182	            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
183	
184	    def start(self) -> None:
185	        parent = self._database_path.parent
186	        if not parent.is_dir():
187	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
188	
189	        with self._condition:
190	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
191	                self._condition.wait()
192	            if self._started:
193	                return
194	            self._starting = True
195	            self._stop_requested = False
196	
197	        observer = None
198	        try:
199	            observer = self._observer_factory()
200	            with self._condition:
201	                self._observer = observer
202	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
203	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
204	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
205	            observer.start()
206	        except Exception:
207	            if observer is not None:
208	                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
209	            with self._condition:
210	                if self._observer is observer:
211	                    self._observer = None
212	                self._started = False
213	                self._starting = False
214	                self._stop_requested = False
215	                self._condition.notify_all()
216	            raise
217	
218	        with self._condition:
219	            self._started = True
220	            self._starting = False
221	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
222	            self._condition.notify_all()
223	
224	        if stop_requested:
225	            self.stop()
226	
227	    def stop(self) -> None:
228	        with self._condition:
229	            if self._starting:
230	                self._stop_requested = True
231	                while self._starting:
232	                    self._condition.wait()
233	            while self._stopping:
234	                self._condition.wait()
235	                if not self._started:
236	                    return
237	            if not self._started:
238	                return
239	            observer = self._observer
240	            self._stopping = True
241	
242	        errors = []
243	        try:
244	            try:
245	                observer.stop()
246	            except Exception as exc:
247	                errors.append(exc)
248	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
249	            try:
250	                observer.join(timeout=10)
251	            except Exception as exc:
252	                errors.append(exc)
253	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
254	
255	            alive = False
256	            try:
257	                alive = observer.is_alive()
258	            except Exception as exc:
259	                errors.append(exc)
260	                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
261	            if alive:
262	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
263	        finally:
264	            with self._condition:
265	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
266	                if cleanup_succeeded:
267	                    self._started = False
268	                    self._observer = None
269	                    self._stop_requested = False
270	                self._stopping = False
271	                self._condition.notify_all()
272	
273	        if errors:
274	            raise errors[0]
275	
```

45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(

62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,

64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69

71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(

100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()

137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):

141	        return True

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (

+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:

147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,

78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False

85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return

95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()

104	        with self._condition:

110	                    self._timer.cancel()

117	            self._timer = None

131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135

137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False

141	        return True

178	def _rows(value: object) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
179	    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
180	    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
181	        return []
182	    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]
183	
184	
185	def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
186	    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
187	    result: List[str] = []
188	    seen = set()
189	    for row in _rows(value):
190	        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
191	            continue
192	        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
193	        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
194	            seen.add(uuid)
195	            result.append(uuid)
196	    return tuple(result)
197	
198	
199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )

138	### Pre-execution Checklist
139	在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：

144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```

Output:

```
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302

323	## 测试策略
324	
325	### 单元测试
326	
327	`tests/test_things_adapter.py`：

1740	
1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.

 class GitSyncClient(Protocol):

 class SyncEngine:
     def __init__(
         self,
         config,
         reader: SnapshotReader,
         git_client: GitSyncClient,
         renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
         reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
     ) -> None:
         self.config = config
         self.reader = reader
         self.git_client = git_client
         self.renderer = renderer
         self.reconciler = reconciler
         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 
     def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
         status["stage"] = "reader"
         snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
         status["stage"] = "renderer"
         rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
         status["stage"] = "reconciler"
         changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
         status["changes"] = changes
         status["stage"] = "git"
         committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
             changes,
             auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
             auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
             remote=self.config.git_remote,
             branch=self.config.git_branch,
         )
         status["committed"] = committed
         status["pushed"] = pushed
         return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
 
     @staticmethod
     def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
         try:
             changes = status["changes"]
             counts = (
                 (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                 if changes is not None
                 else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
             )
             committed = status["committed"]
             pushed = status["pushed"]
             if committed is None:
                 committed = "not executed"
             if pushed is None:
                 pushed = "not executed"
             duration = time.monotonic() - started
             error = status["error"]
             if error is None:
                 _LOG.info(
                     "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
                 )
             else:
                 _LOG.error(
-                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
+                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
                     status["stage"],
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
-                    error,
                 )
         except BaseException:
             # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
             pass
 
     def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
         status = {
             "stage": "reader",
             "changes": None,
             "committed": None,
             "pushed": None,
             "error": None,
         }
         try:
             return self._sync_locked(status)
         except BaseException as error:
             status["error"] = error
             raise
         finally:
             try:
                 self._log_sync(started, status)
             finally:
                 self._lock.release()
 
     def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
         started = time.monotonic()
         self._lock.acquire()
         return self._run_locked(started)
 
     def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
         started = time.monotonic()
         if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
             return False
         self._run_locked(started)
         return True

**Assessing verdict type and quoting lines****Analyzing concurrent start-stop race conditions****Tracing race conditions with concurrent starts****Confirming race condition in DatabaseWatcher start/stop****Providing race condition verdict with code quotes**

</details>

CONFIRMED

Relevant lines:

> `watcher.py:169-171`
> ```python
> if self._started:
>     return
> ```
>
> `watcher.py:179-192`
> ```python
> observer.start()
> ...
> self._observer = observer
> self._started = True
> ```
>
> `watcher.py:194-200`
> ```python
> if not self._started:
>     return
> observer = self._observer
> self._started = False
> self._observer = None
> observer.stop()
> ```
>
> `tests/test_watcher.py:223-245` tests only sequential `start()`/`stop()` calls.

Trigger state/interleaving: Initially `_started` is `False` and `_observer` is `None`. Thread A enters `start()` and blocks in `observer.start()`. Thread B calls `stop()`, observes `_started == False`, and returns. Thread A then assigns `_observer` and sets `_started = True`.

Wrong outcome: `stop()` returns while the watcher becomes active, leaving the observer running. Concurrent `start()` calls can likewise both pass the check and publish competing observers, potentially leaking one.

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
```

+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_watcher_requires_existing_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(
+        tmp_path / "missing" / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_rejects_regular_file_as_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
+    parent.write_text("not a directory")
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(parent / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory)
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails(tmp_path):
+    startup_error = RuntimeError("observer startup failed")
+    observer = Mock()
+    observer.start.side_effect = startup_error
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="observer startup failed") as raised:
+        watcher.start()
+
+    assert raised.value is startup_error
+    observer.stop.assert_called_once_with()
+    observer.join.assert_called_once_with(timeout=10)
+
+
+    observer = FakeObserver(alive=True)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+    watcher.start()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        watcher.stop()
+    assert "did not stop" in caplog.text

171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
206	
```

22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

```
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
```
