65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()

111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()

121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:

125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:

168	        self._started = False
169	        self._starting = False
170	        self._stopping = False
171	        self._stop_requested = False
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
175	        try:
176	            observer.stop()
177	        except Exception:
178	            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
179	        try:
180	            observer.join(timeout=10)
181	        except Exception:
182	            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
183	
184	    def start(self) -> None:
185	        parent = self._database_path.parent
186	        if not parent.is_dir():
187	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
188	
189	        with self._condition:
190	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
191	                self._condition.wait()
192	            if self._started:
193	                return
194	            self._starting = True
195	            self._stop_requested = False
196	
197	        observer = None
198	        try:
199	            observer = self._observer_factory()
200	            with self._condition:
201	                self._observer = observer
202	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
203	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
204	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
205	            observer.start()
206	        except Exception:
207	            if observer is not None:
208	                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
209	            with self._condition:
210	                if self._observer is observer:
211	                    self._observer = None
212	                self._started = False
213	                self._starting = False
214	                self._stop_requested = False
215	                self._condition.notify_all()
216	            raise
217	
218	        with self._condition:
219	            self._started = True
220	            self._starting = False
221	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
222	            self._condition.notify_all()
223	
224	        if stop_requested:
225	            self.stop()
226	
227	    def stop(self) -> None:
228	        with self._condition:
229	            if self._starting:
230	                self._stop_requested = True
231	                while self._starting:
232	                    self._condition.wait()
233	            while self._stopping:
234	                self._condition.wait()
235	                if not self._started:
236	                    return
237	            if not self._started:
238	                return
239	            observer = self._observer
240	            self._stopping = True
241	
242	        errors = []
243	        try:
244	            try:
245	                observer.stop()
246	            except Exception as exc:
247	                errors.append(exc)
248	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
249	            try:
250	                observer.join(timeout=10)
251	            except Exception as exc:
252	                errors.append(exc)
253	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
254	
255	            alive = False
256	            try:
257	                alive = observer.is_alive()
258	            except Exception as exc:
259	                errors.append(exc)
260	                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
261	            if alive:
262	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
263	        finally:
264	            with self._condition:
265	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
266	                if cleanup_succeeded:
267	                    self._started = False
268	                    self._observer = None
269	                    self._stop_requested = False
270	                self._stopping = False
271	                self._condition.notify_all()
272	
273	        if errors:
274	            raise errors[0]
275	
```

1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. ./docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1741:`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.

```
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
```

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]

  27 class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):

  65 class DebouncedSync:
  66     """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
  67 
  68     def __init__(
  69         self,
  70         request: Callable[[], bool],
  71         delay: float,
  72         timer_factory=threading.Timer,
  73     ) -> None:
  74         if delay <= 0:
  75             raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
  76         self._request = request
  77         self._delay = delay
  78         self._timer_factory = timer_factory
  79         self._condition = threading.Condition()
  80         self._timer = None
  81         self._running = False
  82         self._pending = False
  83         self._stopped = False
  84         self._generation = 0
  85         self._callback_thread = None
  86 
  87     def start(self) -> None:
  88         """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
  89         with self._condition:
  90             if self._stopped:
  91                 return
  92 
  93     def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
  94         self._generation += 1
  95         generation = self._generation
  96         timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
  97         timer.daemon = True
  98         self._timer = timer
  99         timer.start()

 101     def notify(self) -> None:
 102         with self._condition:
 103             if self._stopped:
 104                 return
 105             self._pending = True
 106             if not self._running:
 107                 if self._timer is not None:
 108                     self._timer.cancel()
 109                 self._schedule_locked()
 110 
 111     def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
 112         with self._condition:
 113             if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
 114                 return
 115             self._timer = None
 116             self._pending = False
 117             self._running = True
 118             self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
 119 
 120         retry = False
 121         try:
 122             retry = not bool(self._request())
 123         except Exception:
 124             _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
 125         finally:
 126             with self._condition:
 127                 self._running = False
 128                 self._callback_thread = None
 129                 if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
 130                     self._pending = False
 131                     self._schedule_locked()
 132                 self._condition.notify_all()
 133 
 134     def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
 135         with self._condition:
 136             if self._stopped:
 137                 running = self._running
 138             else:
 139                 self._stopped = True
 140                 self._pending = False

 145                     timer.cancel()

 147 
 148         if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
 149             with self._condition:

 151                     self._condition.wait()

 154 class DatabaseWatcher:
 155     """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
 156 
 157     def __init__(
 158         self,
 159         database_path: Path,
 160         debounce: DebouncedSync,
 161         observer_factory=Observer,
 162     ) -> None:
 163         self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
 164         self._debounce = debounce
 165         self._observer_factory = observer_factory
 166         self._condition = threading.Condition()
 167         self._observer = None
 168         self._started = False
 169         self._starting = False
 170         self._stopping = False
 171         self._stop_requested = False
 172 
 173     @staticmethod
 174     def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
 175         try:
 176             observer.stop()
 177         except Exception:
 178             _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
 179         try:
 180             observer.join(timeout=10)
 181         except Exception:
 182             _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
 183 
 184     def start(self) -> None:
 185         parent = self._database_path.parent
 186         if not parent.is_dir():
 187             raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
 188 
 189         with self._condition:
 190             while self._starting or self._stopping:
 191                 self._condition.wait()
 192             if self._started:
 193                 return
 194             self._starting = True
 195             self._stop_requested = False
 196 
 197         observer = None
 198         try:
 199             observer = self._observer_factory()
 200             with self._condition:
 201                 self._observer = observer
 202             handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
 203             # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
 204             observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
 205             observer.start()
 206         except Exception:
 207             if observer is not None:
 208                 self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
 209             with self._condition:
 210                 if self._observer is observer:
 211                     self._observer = None
 212                 self._started = False
 213                 self._starting = False
 214                 self._stop_requested = False
 215                 self._condition.notify_all()
 216             raise
 217 
 218         with self._condition:
 219             self._started = True
 220             self._starting = False
 221             stop_requested = self._stop_requested
 222             self._condition.notify_all()
 223 
 224         if stop_requested:
 225             self.stop()
 226 
 227     def stop(self) -> None:
 228         with self._condition:
 229             if self._starting:
 230                 self._stop_requested = True
 231                 while self._starting:
 232                     self._condition.wait()
 233             while self._stopping:
 234                 self._condition.wait()
 235                 if not self._started:
 236                     return
 237             if not self._started:
 238                 return
 239             observer = self._observer
 240             self._stopping = True
 241 
 242         errors = []
 243         try:
 244             try:
 245                 observer.stop()
 246             except Exception as exc:
 247                 errors.append(exc)
 248                 _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
 249             try:
 250                 observer.join(timeout=10)
 251             except Exception as exc:
 252                 errors.append(exc)

 255             alive = False

 261             if alive:
 262                 _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
 263         finally:
 264             with self._condition:
 265                 cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
 266                 if cleanup_succeeded:

 268                     self._observer = None
 269                     self._stop_requested = False
 270                 self._stopping = False

275	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
276	
277	### Git 和分支
278	
279	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
280	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
281	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
282	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
283	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
284	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
285	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
286	
287	### SDD 流程
288	
289	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
290	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
291	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
292	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
293	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
294	- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。
295	
296	### Things3 只读边界
297	
298	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
299	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
315	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
316	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
317	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
318	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
319	
320	### Git 实现
321	
322	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
323	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
324	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
325	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
326	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
327	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。

263	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
264	
265	### Git / 分支
266	
267	- 当前用户要求直接在 `main` 开发；不要重新创建嵌套 worktree，也不要切回旧实现 worktree进行新开发。
268	- 不要对 `main` 做 `reset --hard`、force push、rebase、amend 或删除提交。
269	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或 `git commit`（不带明确路径）。功能提交必须显式列出文件，并使用 `git commit --only`。
270	- 当前 `d4a17d7` 已在 `origin/main` 记录中，先检查其来源和内容，不要假设它只是普通 Task 3 提交。
271	- 不要把用户已有的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store` 或其他无关暂存/未跟踪状态带入后续功能提交。
272	- 提交前用 `git status --short`、`git diff --cached --name-status`、`git show --name-status HEAD` 验证边界。
273	
274	### Worktree / SDD
275	
276	- 不要删除 `.claude/worktrees/*` 或 `.superpowers/sdd/*`；它们是恢复和审查材料。
277	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`。
278	- 不要因为历史提交看起来重复，就擅自 squash 或重写历史。
279	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当作 review BASE；BASE 必须是 implementer dispatch 之前记录的实际提交。
280	- 不要把 implementer 自测当作 task review；规格合规和代码质量两个 verdict 都必须存在。
281	- 不要在 controller 中直接修 reviewer finding；必须恢复原 implementer（前 3 轮）或在第 4–5 轮换更强的新 agent。
282	- 每轮 fix 必须有 covering tests、命令和结果，然后才能 scoped re-review。
283	
284	### Things3 只读边界
285	
286	- 不要直接读取/写入 Things SQLite；业务代码只能通过窄 API 读取。
287	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper，不要构造 `update` 或 `update-project` URL。
288	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
289	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled；状态和 trashed 是两个维度。
290	- 不要输出 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
291	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义，不能只用 `start` 字段重建。
292	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
293	
294	### 文件与路径安全
295	
296	- 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
297	- 后续写文件必须同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时原文件保留。
298	- 已存在但没有生成 marker 的文件不能覆盖；预检阶段要在任何写入前失败。
299	- 只能删除 manifest/marker 明确托管的文件；陌生文件必须保留并记录 warning。
300	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于下一轮当前文件删除集合。
301	- 所有相对路径都要拒绝绝对路径、`..` 和仓库外解析结果。
302	- Python 最低版本为 3.9：避免 `X | None`、`list[str]` 等仅在 3.10+ 可用的写法，优先 `Optional`、`List`、`Tuple`、`Dict`。
303	
304	### Git 同步实现
305	
306	- 生产同步不能使用真实 index 暂存 managed 文件；必须使用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`。
307	- 临时 index 提交成功后，只用 `git reset -q HEAD -- <managed paths>` 刷新真实 index，保留用户无关暂存。
308	- Git 提交失败后，文件可能已经落盘；下一轮仍须依据 manifest 的历史 managed pathspec 检查并恢复提交。
309	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或解决冲突。
310	- 只用 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 记录同步器创建但未推送的提交；不要因为分支一般性领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
311	- Git 命令必须通过带 timeout、捕获 stderr 的 `subprocess.run()`；日志中的 URL userinfo、token、auth-token、password 必须脱敏。
312	- 不要 push 到真实远端、不要加载 launchd、不要修改系统配置，除非用户另行明确要求。
313	
314	## 7. 新对话启动建议

316	新对话第一轮应执行：

+# Things3 Sync MVP 交接文档
+
+> 交接时间：2026-09-05 06:00:34
+> 目标读者：没有本次会话上下文的新对话
+
+## 1. 我们在做什么
+
+当前项目是一个 macOS 上运行的 Things3 → Git Markdown 单向同步服务。
+
+目标流程：
+
+```text
+Things3 SQLite 数据库（只读）
+  → things.py 读取接口
+  → 不可变 Things 快照模型
+  → 确定性 Markdown 渲染
+  → 后续将实现原子文件协调、manifest、Git 隔离提交/推送
+  → 用户指定的 Git 仓库
+```
+
+当前采用的 MVP 设计：
+
+- 所有触发源最终复用同一条“防抖后完整快照”流水线，不维护独立的增量写入和全量写入路径。
+- 每个任务只有一个主位置：`Project > Area > Inbox/Anytime/Someday`。
+- `Today.md` 和 `Upcoming.md` 是由快照派生的动态视图。
+- Things3 数据只读；业务代码不得调用 `complete()`，不得构造 `update` 或 `update-project` URL。
+- 生成文件使用 marker；后续文件协调器只能删除 manifest/marker 明确管理的文件，陌生文件必须保留。
+- 后续 Git 实现必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户预先暂存的无关文件带进同步提交。
+
+设计与实施计划：
+
+- 设计规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp-design.md`
+- 实施计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md`
+- SDD 账本：`.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp/progress.md`
+
+## 2. 当前分支和工作区状态
+
+当前应直接在 `main` 开发，这是本次会话后半段用户明确要求的工作方式。
+
+```text
+branch: main
+HEAD: d4a17d7 feat: render deterministic task markdown
+origin/main: d4a17d7
+```
+
+最近提交顺序：
+
+```text
+d4a17d7 feat: render deterministic task markdown
...
</persisted-output>
```

272	def reconcile(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> ChangeSet:
273	    """Reconcile managed files, preserving unowned paths and writing manifest last."""
274	    repo_path = Path(repo_path)
275	    desired = dict(rendered.files)
276	    for relative_path, content in desired.items():
277	        if not isinstance(relative_path, Path) or not isinstance(content, str):
278	            raise ValueError("rendered files must map paths to text")
279	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_path)
280	    active_containers = _container_mapping(repo_path, rendered)
281	    _preflight_manifest_destination(repo_path)
282	    previous = load_manifest(repo_path)
283	
284	    archived_containers = dict(previous.archived_containers)
285	    archive_moves = []
286	    for key, old_dir in previous.active_containers.items():
287	        if key in active_containers:
288	            continue
289	        archive_dir = archived_containers.get(key, _archive_directory(key, old_dir))
290	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, archive_dir)
291	        archived_containers[key] = archive_dir
292	        for old_path in _managed_paths_in_container(previous.managed_files, old_dir):
293	            archive_moves.append((old_path, _archive_path(old_path, old_dir, archive_dir)))
294	
295	    # Complete ownership preflight must finish before the first filesystem mutation.
296	    for relative_path in sorted(desired):
297	        _preflight_destination(repo_path, relative_path, previous)
298	    for _, archive_path in archive_moves:
299	        _preflight_archive_destination(repo_path, archive_path, previous)
300	
301	    added = []
302	    modified = []
303	    deleted = []
304	    for relative_path in sorted(desired):
305	        destination = repo_path / relative_path
306	        if not destination.exists():
307	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
308	            added.append(relative_path)
309	        elif _read_text(destination) != desired[relative_path]:
310	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
311	            modified.append(relative_path)
312	
313	    archive_paths = set(
314	        path
315	        for archive_dir in archived_containers.values()
316	        for path in previous.managed_files
317	        if _is_relative_to(path, archive_dir)
318	    )
319	    for old_path, archive_path in archive_moves:
320	        source = repo_path / old_path
321	        if not source.exists():
322	            continue
323	        if not source.is_file() or not is_managed_markdown(_read_text(source)):
324	            _LOG.warning("Not deleting unmarked file: %s", old_path)
325	            continue
326	        content = _read_text(source)
327	        destination = repo_path / archive_path
328	        if not destination.exists():
329	            _atomic_write(destination, content)
330	            added.append(archive_path)
331	        elif _read_text(destination) != content:
332	            _atomic_write(destination, content)
333	            modified.append(archive_path)
334	        source.unlink()
335	        deleted.append(old_path)
336	        archive_paths.add(archive_path)
337	
338	    active_previous_paths = set()
339	    for directory in previous.active_containers.values():
340	        active_previous_paths.update(_managed_paths_in_container(previous.managed_files, directory))
341	    stale_paths = set(previous.managed_files) - archive_paths
342	    for relative_path in sorted(stale_paths):
343	        if relative_path in desired or relative_path in deleted:
344	            continue
345	        stale_path = repo_path / relative_path
346	        if not stale_path.exists():
347	            continue
348	        if stale_path.is_file() and is_managed_markdown(_read_text(stale_path)):
349	            stale_path.unlink()
350	            deleted.append(relative_path)
351	        else:
352	            _LOG.warning("Not deleting unmarked file: %s", relative_path)
353	    _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path, previous.active_containers)
354	
355	    new_manifest = Manifest(
356	        managed_files=tuple(sorted(set(desired) | archive_paths)),
357	        active_containers=active_containers,
358	        archived_containers=archived_containers,
359	    )
360	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
361	    manifest_content = _manifest_content(new_manifest)
362	    if not manifest_path.exists():
363	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
364	        added.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
365	    elif _read_text(manifest_path) != manifest_content:
366	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
367	        modified.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
368	
369	    git_paths = set(previous.managed_files) | set(new_manifest.managed_files)

    def start(self) -> None:
        for emitter in self._emitters.copy():
            try:
                emitter.start()
            except Exception:
                self._remove_emitter(emitter)
                raise
        super().start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        BaseThread.stop(self)
        with contextlib.suppress(queue.Full):
            self.event_queue.put_nowait(EventDispatcher.stop_event)

    def join(self, timeout=None):
        """Wait until the thread terminates.

        This blocks the calling thread until the thread whose join() method is
        called terminates -- either normally or through an unhandled exception
        or until the optional timeout occurs.

        When the timeout argument is present and not None, it should be a
        floating point number specifying a timeout for the operation in seconds
        (or fractions thereof). As join() always returns None, you must call
        is_alive() after join() to decide whether a timeout happened -- if the
        thread is still alive, the join() call timed out.

        When the timeout argument is not present or None, the operation will
        block until the thread terminates.

        A thread can be join()ed many times.

        join() raises a RuntimeError if an attempt is made to join the current
        thread as that would cause a deadlock. It is also an error to join() a
        thread before it has been started and attempts to do so raises the same
        exception.

        """
        if not self._initialized:
            raise RuntimeError("Thread.__init__() not called")
        if not self._started.is_set():
            raise RuntimeError("cannot join thread before it is started")
        if self is current_thread():
            raise RuntimeError("cannot join current thread")

        if timeout is None:
            self._wait_for_tstate_lock()
        else:
            # the behavior of a negative timeout isn't documented, but
            # historically .join(timeout=x) for x<0 has acted as if timeout=0
            self._wait_for_tstate_lock(timeout=max(timeout, 0))

    def is_alive(self):
        """Return whether the thread is alive.

        This method returns True just before the run() method starts until just
        after the run() method terminates. See also the module function
        enumerate().

        """
        assert self._initialized, "Thread.__init__() not called"
        if self._is_stopped or not self._started.is_set():
            return False
        self._wait_for_tstate_lock(False)
        return not self._is_stopped

    def schedule(
        self,
        event_handler: FileSystemEventHandler,
        path: str,
        *,
        recursive: bool = False,
        event_filter: list[type[FileSystemEvent]] | None = None,
    ) -> ObservedWatch:
        """Schedules watching a path and calls appropriate methods specified
        in the given event handler in response to file system events.

        :param event_handler:
            An event handler instance that has appropriate event handling
            methods which will be called by the observer in response to
            file system events.
        :type event_handler:
            :class:`watchdog.events.FileSystemEventHandler` or a subclass
        :param path:
            Directory path that will be monitored.
        :type path:
            ``str``
        :param recursive:
            ``True`` if events will be emitted for sub-directories
            traversed recursively; ``False`` otherwise.
        :type recursive:
            ``bool``
        :param event_filter:
            Collection of event types to emit, or None for no filtering (default).
        :type event_filter:
            Iterable[:class:`watchdog.events.FileSystemEvent`] | None
        :return:
            An :class:`ObservedWatch` object instance representing
            a watch.
        """
        with self._lock:
            watch = ObservedWatch(path, recursive=recursive, event_filter=event_filter)
            self._add_handler_for_watch(event_handler, watch)

            # If we don't have an emitter for this watch already, create it.
            if watch not in self._emitter_for_watch:
                emitter = self._emitter_class(self.event_queue, watch, timeout=self.timeout, event_filter=event_filter)
                if self.is_alive():
                    emitter.start()
                self._add_emitter(emitter)
            self._watches.add(watch)
        return watch

.claude/worktrees/agent-a6a321227d8a2320a/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1741:`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.
.claude/worktrees/agent-a6a321227d8a2320a/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1747:`DatabaseWatcher.start()` verifies `database_path.parent` exists, schedules one non-recursive watch on that parent, and starts the observer. `stop()` calls `observer.stop()` then `observer.join(timeout=10)`; if still alive, log an error. 65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()

156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,

215

44	        self.reader = reader

46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,

62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(

100	                    status["stage"],

102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False

1720	
1721	Implement a `FakeTimer` in the test that records `start`, `cancel`, and exposes `fire()`. Tests must prove:
1722

1724	- A notification while `request()` is executing sets a pending flag; after request returns, exactly one new timer is scheduled.

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )

1	"""Explicit-path Git operations that preserve unrelated staged changes."""

8	from dataclasses import dataclass
9	from datetime import datetime

17	PENDING_PUSH_REF = "refs/things3-sync/pending-push"
18	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
19	_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s'\"<>]+")
20	_SECRET_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)\b(token|auth-token|password)=([^&#\s]+)")
21	_RENAME_OR_COPY = {"R", "C"}
22	_COMMIT_NO_DIFF = "no-diff"
23	_COMMIT_SUCCESS = "commit-success"
24	_COMMIT_FAILURE = "commit-failure"

34	def generate_commit_message(counts: ChangeCounts, now: datetime) -> str:
35	    """Build the stable message used for managed sync commits."""
36	    return "Update: {} | Added {}, Modified {}, Deleted {}".format(
37	        now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), counts.added, counts.modified, counts.deleted
38	    )
39	
40	
41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:
48	        return value
49	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))
50	
51	
52	def _redact_credentials(text: str) -> str:
53	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
54	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
55	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

60

62	def _counts_from_name_status(output: str) -> ChangeCounts:
63	    fields = output.split("\0")
64	    index = 0
65	    added = modified = deleted = 0
66	    while index < len(fields):
67	        status = fields[index]
68	        if not status:
69	            break
70	        index += 1
71	        code = status[0]
72	        if code in _RENAME_OR_COPY:
73	            index += 2
74	        else:
75	            index += 1
76	        if code == "A":
77	            added += 1
78	        elif code == "D":
79	            deleted += 1
80	        else:
81	            modified += 1
82	    return ChangeCounts(added, modified, deleted)

85	class GitClient:

89	        self,

101	    ) -> Optional[subprocess.CompletedProcess]:

165	            index_path.unlink()
166	            index_env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
167	            seeded = self._run(["read-tree", "HEAD"], index_env)
168	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:
169	                return False
170	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
174	            if diff is None:
175	                return False
176	            if diff.returncode == 0:
177	                self._commit_state = _COMMIT_NO_DIFF
178	                return False
179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)

    def schedule(
        self,
        event_handler: FileSystemEventHandler,
        path: str,
        *,
        recursive: bool = False,
        event_filter: list[type[FileSystemEvent]] | None = None,
    ) -> ObservedWatch:
        """Schedules watching a path and calls appropriate methods specified
        in the given event handler in response to file system events.

        :param event_handler:
            An event handler instance that has appropriate event handling
            methods which will be called by the observer in response to
            file system events.
        :type event_handler:
            :class:`watchdog.events.FileSystemEventHandler` or a subclass
        :param path:
            Directory path that will be monitored.
        :type path:
            ``str``
        :param recursive:
            ``True`` if events will be emitted for sub-directories
            traversed recursively; ``False`` otherwise.
        :type recursive:
            ``bool``
        :param event_filter:
            Collection of event types to emit, or None for no filtering (default).
        :type event_filter:
            Iterable[:class:`watchdog.events.FileSystemEvent`] | None
        :return:
            An :class:`ObservedWatch` object instance representing
            a watch.
        """
        with self._lock:
            watch = ObservedWatch(path, recursive=recursive, event_filter=event_filter)
            self._add_handler_for_watch(event_handler, watch)

            # If we don't have an emitter for this watch already, create it.
            if watch not in self._emitter_for_watch:
                emitter = self._emitter_class(self.event_queue, watch, timeout=self.timeout, event_filter=event_filter)
                if self.is_alive():
                    emitter.start()
                self._add_emitter(emitter)
            self._watches.add(watch)
        return watch

    def start(self) -> None:
        for emitter in self._emitters.copy():
            try:
                emitter.start()
            except Exception:
                self._remove_emitter(emitter)
                raise
        super().start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        BaseThread.stop(self)
        with contextlib.suppress(queue.Full):
            self.event_queue.put_nowait(EventDispatcher.stop_event)

class BaseThread(threading.Thread):
    """Convenience class for creating stoppable threads."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        threading.Thread.__init__(self)
        if hasattr(self, "daemon"):
            self.daemon = True
        else:
            self.setDaemon(True)
        self._stopped_event = threading.Event()

    @property
    def stopped_event(self) -> threading.Event:
        return self._stopped_event

    def should_keep_running(self) -> bool:
        """Determines whether the thread should continue running."""
        return not self._stopped_event.is_set()

    def on_thread_stop(self) -> None:
        """Override this method instead of :meth:`stop()`.
        :meth:`stop()` calls this method.

        This method is called immediately after the thread is signaled to stop.
        """

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Signals the thread to stop."""
        self._stopped_event.set()
        self.on_thread_stop()

    def on_thread_start(self) -> None:
        """Override this method instead of :meth:`start()`. :meth:`start()`
        calls this method.

        This method is called right before this thread is started and this
        object's run() method is invoked.
        """

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.on_thread_start()
        threading.Thread.start(self)
```

## Findings

1. **P1: `stop()` can orphan a still-running observer**
   - **File:** [`src/watcher.py:194-203`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:194)
   - **Summary:** The observer handle and `_started` state are cleared before `join()` confirms shutdown. If `join(timeout=10)` returns while the observer is still alive, later `stop()` calls become no-ops and cannot retry shutdown.
   - **Trigger/failure scenario:** An observer thread remains alive beyond 10 seconds because an emitter or filesystem backend is blocked. `stop()` logs the timeout, returns, and a subsequent `stop()` does nothing while the observer can still dispatch filesystem events.
   - **Quoted lines:**  
     > `self._started = False`  
     > `self._observer = None`  
     > `observer.join(timeout=10)`  
     > `if observer.is_alive():`

2. **P1: Debouncer waiters can block indefinitely if retry scheduling raises**
   - **File:** [`src/watcher.py:125-132`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:125)
   - **Summary:** `_schedule_locked()` runs inside `_fire()`’s `finally` block before `notify_all()`. If timer construction or `timer.start()` raises, the condition notification is skipped.
   - **Trigger/failure scenario:** A custom `timer_factory`, or the real timer under thread/resource exhaustion, raises while scheduling the pending rerun. A concurrent `stop(wait=True)` is already waiting on the condition and never receives the wake-up notification.
   - **Quoted lines:**  
     > `self._running = False`  
     > `if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):`  
     > `self._schedule_locked()`  
     > `self._condition.notify_all()`

3. **P2: Observer setup failures during `schedule()` bypass cleanup**
   - **File:** [`src/watcher.py:175-190`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:175)
   - **Summary:** Cleanup covers only `observer.start()`. Exceptions from `DatabaseEventFilter` construction or `observer.schedule()` leave any partially initialized observer state without `stop()`/`join()`.
   - **Trigger/failure scenario:** A watchdog backend or injected observer raises while creating or registering the watch, after the factory has returned an observer. The exception propagates and the local observer is abandoned without the startup cleanup path.
   - **Quoted lines:**  
     > `observer = self._observer_factory()`  
     > `handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)`  
     > `observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)`  
     > `try:`  
     > `    observer.start()`

4. **P2: Sync failure logs lose exception identity and traceback**
   - **File:** [`src/sync_engine.py:86-107`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/sync_engine.py:86)
   - **Summary:** The change removes the exception representation entirely and emits only `error=present`. Failure propagation remains intact, but operational logs no longer identify the exception class/message or provide a traceback.
   - **Trigger/failure scenario:** Any reader, renderer, reconciler, or Git failure reaches `_log_sync()`. Operators see the stage and counts but cannot distinguish, for example, a permission error from a malformed snapshot without reproducing the failure.
   - **Quoted lines:**  
     > `error = status["error"]`  
     > `_LOG.error(`  
     > `"sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs ... error=present",`

## Trace and verification

- `DatabaseEventFilter.on_modified/on_created/on_deleted/on_moved()` call `_handle()`, which calls `_normalize_path()` and `request_sync`.
- `DebouncedSync.notify()` calls `_schedule_locked()`, which calls the injected `timer_factory`; timer callbacks call `_fire()`, which calls the injected `request`.
- `DatabaseWatcher.start()` calls `observer_factory()`, `DatabaseEventFilter`, `observer.schedule()`, and `observer.start()`. `stop()` calls `observer.stop()`, `join()`, and `is_alive()`.
- There are currently no production imports or callers of the watcher classes; callers are confined to [`tests/test_watcher.py`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/tests/test_watcher.py:8). The planned service layer is not present yet.

Its `watchdog>=2.1,<7` range and the current project target of Python 3.9+ are compatible with the watcher’s typing and threading constructs. `Agent.md` still mentions Python 3.6+, which conflicts with the newer 3.9+ project specification and existing `Protocol`/`Literal` usage.

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
24	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
25	
26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync
30	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
31	            database,
32	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
33	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
34	        }
35	
36	    @staticmethod
37	    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
38	        if not path:
39	            return None
40	        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
41	
42	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
43	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
44	            return
45	        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
46	            self._request_sync()
47	
48	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
49	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
50	
51	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
52	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
53

55	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))

61	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),

63	            ),

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154

158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,

163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce

168	        self._observer = None

180	        try:

182	        except Exception:

184	            try:

186	            except Exception:

188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise

195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:

201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
24	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
25	
26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync
30	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
31	            database,
32	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
33	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),

35	
36	    @staticmethod
37	    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
38	        if not path:
39	            return None
40	        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
41	
42	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
43	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
44	            return
45	        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
46	            self._request_sync()
47

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154

156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.exists():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            raise
185	        self._observer = observer
186	        self._started = True
187	
188	    def stop(self) -> None:
189	        if not self._started:
190	            return
191	        observer = self._observer
192	        self._started = False
193	        self._observer = None
194	        observer.stop()
195	        observer.join(timeout=10)
196	        if observer.is_alive():
197	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
