+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_watcher_requires_existing_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(
+        tmp_path / "missing" / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()

+
+
+def test_watcher_rejects_regular_file_as_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
+    parent.write_text("not a directory")
+    observer_factory = Mock()

112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
24	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""

26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync

36	    @staticmethod

38	        if not path:

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()

156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():

50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)

64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69

71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:

100	                    status["stage"],

102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

24	    @classmethod
25	    def from_env(cls, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, *, git_runner: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess] = subprocess.run) -> "AppConfig":
26	        values = os.environ if env is None else env
27	        raw_repo = values.get("REPO_PATH", "").strip()
28	        if not raw_repo: raise ValueError("REPO_PATH is required")
29	        repo = Path(raw_repo).expanduser().resolve()
30	        if not repo.exists() or not repo.is_dir(): raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be an existing directory: {repo}")
31	        def number(name, default, cast=float, positive=False, nonnegative=False):
32	            try: result = cast(values.get(name, str(default)))
33	            except (TypeError, ValueError): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be numeric")
34	            if positive and result <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
35	            if nonnegative and result < 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
36	            return result
37	        timeout = number("GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 30.0, float, positive=True)
38	        level = values.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO").strip().upper()
39	        if level not in {"DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"}: raise ValueError(f"Unsupported log level: {level}")
40	        auto_commit = parse_bool("AUTO_COMMIT", values.get("AUTO_COMMIT", "true"))
41	        auto_push = parse_bool("AUTO_PUSH", values.get("AUTO_PUSH", "true"))
42	        if auto_push and not auto_commit: raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
43	        result = git_runner(["git", "rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
44	        if result.returncode != 0 or result.stdout.strip() != "true": raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be a Git work tree: {repo}")
45	        branch_result = git_runner(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
46	        branch = branch_result.stdout.strip()
47	        configured_branch = values.get("GIT_BRANCH", "main").strip()
48	        if not branch: raise ValueError("GIT_BRANCH cannot be used with detached HEAD")
49	        if branch != configured_branch: raise ValueError(f"GIT_BRANCH {configured_branch} does not match checked-out branch {branch}")
50	        things = values.get("THINGSDB", "").strip()

178	def _rows(value: object) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
179	    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
180	    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
181	        return []
182	    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]
183	
184	
185	def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
186	    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
187	    result: List[str] = []
188	    seen = set()
189	    for row in _rows(value):
190	        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
191	            continue
192	        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
193	        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
194	            seen.add(uuid)
195	            result.append(uuid)
196	    return tuple(result)
197	
198	
199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )
275

145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`

178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。

300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
315	- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
316	- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
317	- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
318	- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。
319	
320	### Git 实现
321	
322	- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
323	- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
324	- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
325	- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
326	- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
327	- 不要对真实远端执行 push。
328

**Findings**

1. **Test raises `NameError` instead of checking shutdown logging**  
   File: [`tests/test_watcher.py:284-289`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/tests/test_watcher.py:284)  
   `test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails()` uses `caplog` but does not declare it as a fixture parameter. The full test suite therefore fails after the watcher assertions with `NameError: name 'caplog' is not defined`. Concrete scenario: any normal run reaches the `FakeObserver(alive=True)` branch and aborts before validating the timeout log.

2. **Concurrent `start()` / `stop()` can leave an observer running after shutdown**  
   Files: [`src/watcher.py:171-194`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:171), [`src/watcher.py:196-205`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:196)  
   `_started` is checked and assigned without synchronization, and `_observer` is assigned only after `observer.start()` returns. Scenario: service startup calls `watcher.start()` while a signal handler calls `watcher.stop()`. `stop()` observes `_started == False` and returns; `start()` then completes and publishes a live observer. Shutdown has already returned, so the observer remains active and future filesystem events continue arriving.

3. **Observer scheduling failures bypass cleanup**  
   File: [`src/watcher.py:177-192`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:177)  
   Cleanup is wrapped around `observer.start()` only; `observer.schedule()` executes before the `try`. Scenario: watchdog rejects the parent path or a custom/platform observer raises during scheduling. The newly created observer is abandoned without `stop()`/`join()`, and the original scheduling exception propagates. This is inconsistent with the explicit cleanup behavior for startup failures and is especially relevant when future `service.run()` startup propagates the exception.

4. **Observer stop failure can permanently lose lifecycle ownership**  
   File: [`src/watcher.py:196-205`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:196)  
   `_started` is set to `False` and `_observer` cleared before `observer.stop()` and `join()`. Scenario: `observer.stop()` raises while its worker is still alive. A subsequent `watcher.stop()` is a no-op because the wrapper now believes it is stopped, leaving the observer unmanaged. The planned service shutdown then cannot retry cleanup.

5. **Planned service shutdown can skip debouncer shutdown if watcher shutdown raises**  
   Planned integration: [`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1828-1830`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-things3-sync-mvp.md:1828), with watcher behavior at [`src/watcher.py:196-205`](/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:196)  
   The planned `finally` calls `watcher.stop()` and then `debouncer.stop(wait=True)` without nested cleanup handling. Scenario: `watcher.stop()` raises from observer shutdown; control leaves the `finally` block before `debouncer.stop()`, so a running timer/callback may outlive `SyncService.run()`. This is a cross-file lifecycle risk rather than an existing `src/service.py` implementation issue, because that module is not present yet.

44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

1	"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	from pathlib import Path
6	from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
7	
8	try:
9	    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
10	    from watchdog.observers import Observer
11	except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
12	    class FileSystemEventHandler:
13	        pass
14	
15	    class Observer:
16	        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
17	            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
18

21	
22	
23	def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
24	    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
25	
26	
27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51	
52	    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,
58	            (
59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )
63	
64	
65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
204

```
"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""

import logging
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple

from .filesystem import reconcile
from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
from .renderer import render_snapshot


_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
        ...


class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
    def sync(
        self,
        changes: ChangeSet,
        auto_commit: bool,
        auto_push: bool,
        remote: str,
        branch: str,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
        ...


class SyncEngine:
    def __init__(
        self,
        config,
        reader: SnapshotReader,
        git_client: GitSyncClient,
        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.reader = reader
        self.git_client = git_client
        self.renderer = renderer
        self.reconciler = reconciler
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
        status["stage"] = "reader"
        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
        status["stage"] = "renderer"
        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
        status["changes"] = changes
        status["stage"] = "git"
        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
            changes,
            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
            remote=self.config.git_remote,
            branch=self.config.git_branch,
        )
        status["committed"] = committed
        status["pushed"] = pushed
        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)

    @staticmethod
    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
        try:
            changes = status["changes"]
            counts = (
                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                if changes is not None
                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
            )
            committed = status["committed"]
            pushed = status["pushed"]
            if committed is None:
                committed = "not executed"
            if pushed is None:
                pushed = "not executed"
            duration = time.monotonic() - started
            error = status["error"]
            if error is None:
                _LOG.info(
                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                )
            else:
                _LOG.error(
                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
                    status["stage"],
                    duration,
                    counts[0],
                    counts[1],
                    counts[2],
                    committed,
                    pushed,
                    error,
                )
        except BaseException:
            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
            pass

    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
        status = {
            "stage": "reader",
            "changes": None,
            "committed": None,
            "pushed": None,
            "error": None,
        }
        try:
            return self._sync_locked(status)
        except BaseException as error:
            status["error"] = error
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                self._log_sync(started, status)
            finally:
                self._lock.release()

    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
        started = time.monotonic()
        self._lock.acquire()
        return self._run_locked(started)

    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
        started = time.monotonic()
        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return False
        self._run_locked(started)
        return True
import logging
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from src.models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
import src.sync_engine as sync_engine_module
from src.sync_engine import SyncEngine


def config(repo_path):
    return Mock(
        repo_path=repo_path,
        auto_commit=True,
        auto_push=False,
        git_remote="origin",
        git_branch="main",
    )


def test_sync_runs_single_pipeline_in_order(tmp_path):
    snapshot = ThingsSnapshot()
    rendered = RenderedSnapshot({}, ())
    changes = ChangeSet(added=(Path("Inbox.md"),))
    calls = []
    reader = Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(side_effect=lambda: calls.append("read") or snapshot))
    renderer = Mock(side_effect=lambda value: calls.append("render") or rendered)
    reconciler = Mock(side_effect=lambda repo, value: calls.append("reconcile") or changes)
    git = Mock(sync=Mock(side_effect=lambda *args, **kwargs: calls.append("git") or (True, False)))
    engine = SyncEngine(config(tmp_path), reader, git, renderer, reconciler)

    result = engine.sync()

    assert calls == ["read", "render", "reconcile", "git"]
    assert result == SyncResult(changes, committed=True, pushed=False)


def test_read_failure_prevents_render_write_and_git(tmp_path):
    reader = Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(side_effect=OSError("locked")))
    renderer = Mock()
    reconciler = Mock()
    git = Mock()
    engine = SyncEngine(config(tmp_path), reader, git, renderer, reconciler)

    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="locked"):
        engine.sync()

    assert not list(tmp_path.iterdir())
    renderer.assert_not_called()
    reconciler.assert_not_called()
    git.sync.assert_not_called()


def test_empty_changes_are_still_passed_to_git(tmp_path):
    changes = ChangeSet()
    git = Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(False, False)))
    engine = SyncEngine(
        config(tmp_path),
        Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(return_value=ThingsSnapshot())),
        git,
        Mock(return_value=RenderedSnapshot({}, ())),
        Mock(return_value=changes),
    )

    result = engine.sync()

    assert result == SyncResult(changes)
    git.sync.assert_called_once_with(
        changes,
        auto_commit=True,
        auto_push=False,
        remote="origin",
        branch="main",
    )


def test_sync_if_idle_is_nonblocking_and_can_run_again(tmp_path):
    entered = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()
    calls = []

    def read_snapshot():
        calls.append("read")
        entered.set()
        release.wait(timeout=2)
        return ThingsSnapshot()

    engine = SyncEngine(
        config(tmp_path),
        Mock(read_snapshot=read_snapshot),
        Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(False, False))),
        Mock(return_value=RenderedSnapshot({}, ())),
        Mock(return_value=ChangeSet()),
    )
    first = threading.Thread(target=engine.sync)
    first.start()
    assert entered.wait(timeout=2)

    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is False
    assert calls == ["read"]

    release.set()
    first.join(timeout=2)
    assert not first.is_alive()
    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True
    assert calls == ["read", "read"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failed_stage", ["renderer", "reconciler", "git"])
def test_pipeline_failure_stops_later_stages_and_releases_lock(tmp_path, failed_stage):
    snapshot = ThingsSnapshot()
    rendered = RenderedSnapshot({}, ())
    changes = ChangeSet()
    calls = []
    failure = {"stage": failed_stage}
    reader = Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(side_effect=lambda: calls.append("read") or snapshot))

    def render(value):
        calls.append("render")
        if failure["stage"] == "renderer":
            raise RuntimeError("renderer failed")
        return rendered

    def reconcile(repo, value):
        calls.append("reconcile")
        if failure["stage"] == "reconciler":
            raise RuntimeError("reconciler failed")
        return changes

    def git_sync(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append("git")
        if failure["stage"] == "git":
            raise RuntimeError("git failed")
        return (False, False)

    renderer = Mock(side_effect=render)
    reconciler = Mock(side_effect=reconcile)
    git = Mock(sync=Mock(side_effect=git_sync))
    engine = SyncEngine(config(tmp_path), reader, git, renderer, reconciler)

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=failed_stage):
        engine.sync()

    assert calls == {
        "renderer": ["read", "render"],
        "reconciler": ["read", "render", "reconcile"],
        "git": ["read", "render", "reconcile", "git"],
    }[failed_stage]

    failure["stage"] = None
    calls.clear()
    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True
    assert calls == ["read", "render", "reconcile", "git"]


def test_sync_logs_counts_results_and_failure_markers(tmp_path, caplog):
    changes = ChangeSet(
        added=(Path("a.md"), Path("b.md")),
        modified=(Path("c.md"),),
        deleted=(Path("d.md"),),
    )
    renderer = Mock(return_value=RenderedSnapshot({}, ()))
    reconciler = Mock(return_value=changes)
    git = Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(True, False)))
    engine = SyncEngine(
        config(tmp_path),
        Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(return_value=ThingsSnapshot())),
        git,
        renderer,
        reconciler,
    )

    with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger=sync_engine_module._LOG.name):
        engine.sync()

    message = caplog.records[-1].getMessage()
    assert "duration=" in message
    assert "added=2 modified=1 deleted=1" in message
    assert "committed=True pushed=False" in message

    failing_renderer = Mock(side_effect=ValueError("render failed"))
    failing_engine = SyncEngine(
        config(tmp_path),
        Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(return_value=ThingsSnapshot())),
        Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(False, False))),
        failing_renderer,
        Mock(),
    )
    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger=sync_engine_module._LOG.name):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="render failed"):
            failing_engine.sync()
    message = caplog.records[-1].getMessage()
    assert "stage=renderer" in message
    assert "added=unavailable" in message
    assert "committed=not executed pushed=not executed" in message


def test_logging_handler_failure_does_not_mask_error_or_lock_release(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    renderer = Mock(side_effect=ValueError("render failed"))
    engine = SyncEngine(
        config(tmp_path),
        Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(return_value=ThingsSnapshot())),
        Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(False, False))),
        renderer,
        Mock(),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(sync_engine_module._LOG, "error", Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("log failed")))

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="render failed"):
        engine.sync()

    renderer.side_effect = None
    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True

160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text

210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302	
303	## 配置与部署
304	
305	项目提供：
306	
307	- `.env.example`
308	- `requirements.txt`
309	- `setup.py` 交互式配置脚本
310	- `generate_launchd.py`
311	- `main.py`
312	- README 安装和运维说明
313	
314	依赖基线：
315	
316	- Python 3.9+
317	- `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`
318	- `watchdog>=2.1,<7`
319	- `python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`
320	
321	launchd 生成器在项目内生成 plist 预览。用户通过明确的 setup 步骤安装到 `~/Library/LaunchAgents`，普通同步进程不修改系统 launchd 配置。
322	
323	## 测试策略
324	
325	### 单元测试
326	
327	`tests/test_things_adapter.py`：
328	
329	- 使用内嵌参考库的 SQLite fixture 或等价测试数据库，通过 `THINGSDB` 注入。
330	- 验证稀疏字典规范化、状态映射、空字段、Project/Area/Heading 关系。

332	- 验证适配器只调用读取 API。

337	- Today/Upcoming 派生重复展示。
338	- 完成和取消文件。
339	- Markdown 特殊字符、多行 Notes、Checklist 状态。
```

1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.

**Findings**

1. **`src/watcher.py:124` — Debounced failures bypass the new exception redaction.**  
   **Trigger:** A timer-driven sync fails with an exception containing a sensitive path or credential, such as `ValueError("...password=SECRET")`. `DebouncedSync` logs the complete traceback, including the exception text, even though `SyncEngine` now emits only `error=present`.  
   **Quoted lines:**
   ```python
   122        try:
   123            retry = not bool(self._request())
   124        except Exception:
   125            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
   ```
   This violates the stated logging invariant that sensitive paths and tokens must not be recorded.

2. **`tests/test_watcher.py:287` — Test references an undeclared `caplog` fixture.**  
   **Trigger:** Running `test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails` reaches the context manager and raises `NameError: name 'caplog' is not defined`, so the timeout-log assertion never executes.  
   **Quoted lines:**
   ```python
   287    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
   288        watcher.stop()
   289    assert "did not stop" in caplog.text
   ```

3. **`src/sync_engine.py:99` — Failure logs lose exception category and diagnostic context.**  
   **Trigger:** Any reader/renderer/reconciler/Git failure is logged only with `stage=...` and `error=present`; operators cannot distinguish, for example, a `PermissionError` from a `ValueError` without inspecting another logging path.  
   **Quoted replacement:**
   ```python
   99                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
   ```
   **Deleted lines:**
   ```python
   "sync failed ... error=%r"
   ...
   error,
   ```
   This is a privacy improvement against raw exception messages, but it also drops the design-required exception category/context. A sanitized exception type and redacted context would preserve both properties.

**Explicit checks**

- `requirements.txt` is unchanged.
- The watchdog fallback imports successfully when `watchdog` is absent; constructing the fallback observer raises the intended `ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")`.
- `DatabaseWatcher`’s default factory is correctly bound to the module’s imported `Observer` (`__defaults__[0] is Observer`). Dynamic monkeypatching or installing watchdog after module import would not change that bound default, but this is normal Python default-argument behavior and is not a runtime defect under the project’s dependency model.
- `py_compile` passed for all scoped Python files. `pytest` was not installed in the environment, so the test suite could not be executed.

61	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154	
155	
156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
206	
```

17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):

19	        ...

22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):

24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,

29	        branch: str,

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,

39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:

44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

79	def test_sync_if_idle_is_nonblocking_and_can_run_again(tmp_path):
80	    entered = threading.Event()
81	    release = threading.Event()
82	    calls = []
83	
84	    def read_snapshot():
85	        calls.append("read")
86	        entered.set()
87	        release.wait(timeout=2)
88	        return ThingsSnapshot()
89	
90	    engine = SyncEngine(
91	        config(tmp_path),
92	        Mock(read_snapshot=read_snapshot),
93	        Mock(sync=Mock(return_value=(False, False))),
94	        Mock(return_value=RenderedSnapshot({}, ())),
95	        Mock(return_value=ChangeSet()),
96	    )
97	    first = threading.Thread(target=engine.sync)
98	    first.start()
99	    assert entered.wait(timeout=2)
100	
101	    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is False
102	    assert calls == ["read"]
103	
104	    release.set()
105	    first.join(timeout=2)
106	    assert not first.is_alive()
107	    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True
108	    assert calls == ["read", "read"]
109

111	@pytest.mark.parametrize("failed_stage", ["renderer", "reconciler", "git"])
112	def test_pipeline_failure_stops_later_stages_and_releases_lock(tmp_path, failed_stage):
113	    snapshot = ThingsSnapshot()
114	    rendered = RenderedSnapshot({}, ())
115	    changes = ChangeSet()
116	    calls = []
117	    failure = {"stage": failed_stage}
118	    reader = Mock(read_snapshot=Mock(side_effect=lambda: calls.append("read") or snapshot))
119	
120	    def render(value):
121	        calls.append("render")
122	        if failure["stage"] == "renderer":
123	            raise RuntimeError("renderer failed")
124	        return rendered
125	
126	    def reconcile(repo, value):
127	        calls.append("reconcile")
128	        if failure["stage"] == "reconciler":
129	            raise RuntimeError("reconciler failed")
130	        return changes
131	
132	    def git_sync(*args, **kwargs):
133	        calls.append("git")
134	        if failure["stage"] == "git":
135	            raise RuntimeError("git failed")
136	        return (False, False)
137	
138	    renderer = Mock(side_effect=render)
139	    reconciler = Mock(side_effect=reconcile)
140	    git = Mock(sync=Mock(side_effect=git_sync))
141	    engine = SyncEngine(config(tmp_path), reader, git, renderer, reconciler)
142	
143	    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=failed_stage):
144	        engine.sync()
145	
146	    assert calls == {
147	        "renderer": ["read", "render"],
148	        "reconciler": ["read", "render", "reconcile"],
149	        "git": ["read", "render", "reconcile", "git"],
150	    }[failed_stage]
151	
152	    failure["stage"] = None
153	    calls.clear()
154	    assert engine.sync_if_idle() is True
155	    assert calls == ["read", "render", "reconcile", "git"]

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
