+++ b/tests/test_watcher.py
@@ -0,0 +1,289 @@
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_watcher_requires_existing_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(
+        tmp_path / "missing" / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_rejects_regular_file_as_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
+    parent.write_text("not a directory")
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(parent / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory)
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails(tmp_path):
+    startup_error = RuntimeError("observer startup failed")
+    observer = Mock()
+    observer.start.side_effect = startup_error
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="observer startup failed") as raised:
+        watcher.start()
+

150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302	
303	## 配置与部署
304	
305	项目提供：
306	
307	- `.env.example`
308	- `requirements.txt`
309	- `setup.py` 交互式配置脚本
310	- `generate_launchd.py`
311	- `main.py`
312	- README 安装和运维说明
313	
314	依赖基线：
315	
316	- Python 3.9+
317	- `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`
318	- `watchdog>=2.1,<7`
319	- `python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`
320	
321	launchd 生成器在项目内生成 plist 预览。用户通过明确的 setup 步骤安装到 `~/Library/LaunchAgents`，普通同步进程不修改系统 launchd 配置。
322	
323	## 测试策略
324	
325	### 单元测试
326	
327	`tests/test_things_adapter.py`：

329	- 使用内嵌参考库的 SQLite fixture 或等价测试数据库，通过 `THINGSDB` 注入。

339	- Markdown 特殊字符、多行 Notes、Checklist 状态。

> `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:24`

> `if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):`

A concrete symlink failure remains when `DatabaseWatcher` receives a symlink to the database file directly: its handler resolves the link, but startup watches the unnormalized path’s parent:

> `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:163`  
> `self._database_path = Path(database_path)`

> `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py:172-177`  
> `parent = self._database_path.parent`  
> `observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)`

For `alias/main.sqlite -> real/main.sqlite`, the watcher observes `alias.parent`, while SQLite events occur under `real.parent`. The normal `THINGSDB` configuration path mitigates this because `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/config.py:51` applies `.expanduser().resolve()` before storing the path.

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
24	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
25	
26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync
30	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
31	            database,
32	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
33	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
34	        }
35	
36	    @staticmethod
37	    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
38	        if not path:
39	            return None
40	        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
41	
42	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
43	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
44	            return
45	        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
46	            self._request_sync()
47	
48	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
49	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))

55	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))

61	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),

63	            ),
64	        )

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154

156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalized(path) -> Optional[Path]:
+        if not path:
+            return None
+        return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
```

+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+

+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []

+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):

+    def start(self):

+
+    def stop(self):

+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):

+    def is_alive(self):

+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):

1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending.     65	class DebouncedSync:
    66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
    67	
    68	    def __init__(
    69	        self,
    70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
    71	        delay: float,
    72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
    73	    ) -> None:
    74	        if delay <= 0:
    75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
    76	        self._request = request
    77	        self._delay = delay
    78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
    79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
    80	        self._timer = None
    81	        self._running = False
    82	        self._pending = False
    83	        self._stopped = False
    84	        self._generation = 0
    85	        self._callback_thread = None
    86	
    87	    def start(self) -> None:
    88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
    89	        with self._condition:
    90	            if self._stopped:
    91	                return
    92	
    93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
    94	        self._generation += 1
    95	        generation = self._generation
    96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
    97	        timer.daemon = True
    98	        self._timer = timer
    99	        timer.start()
   100	
   101	    def notify(self) -> None:
   102	        with self._condition:
   103	            if self._stopped:
   104	                return
   105	            self._pending = True
   106	            if not self._running:
   107	                if self._timer is not None:
   108	                    self._timer.cancel()
   109	                self._schedule_locked()
   110	
   111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
   112	        with self._condition:
   113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
   114	                return
   115	            self._timer = None
   116	            self._pending = False
   117	            self._running = True
   118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
   119	
   120	        retry = False
   121	        try:
   122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
   123	        except Exception:
   124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
   125	        finally:
   126	            with self._condition:
   127	                self._running = False
   128	                self._callback_thread = None
   129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
   130	                    self._pending = False
   131	                    self._schedule_locked()
   132	                self._condition.notify_all()
   133	
   134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
   135	        with self._condition:
   136	            if self._stopped:
   137	                running = self._running
   138	            else:
   139	                self._stopped = True
   140	                self._pending = False
   141	                self._generation += 1
   142	                timer = self._timer
   143	                self._timer = None
   144	                if timer is not None:
   145	                    timer.cancel()
   146	                running = self._running
   147	
   148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
   149	            with self._condition:
   150	                while self._running:
   151	                    self._condition.wait()

191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
204	
```

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
```

274	
275	## 6. 绝对不要踩的坑
276	
277	### Git 和分支
278	
279	- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
280	- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
281	- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
282	- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
283	- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
284	- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
285	- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。
286	
287	### SDD 流程
288	
289	- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
290	- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
291	- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
292	- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
293	- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
294	- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。
295	
296	### Things3 只读边界
297	
298	- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
299	- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
300	- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
301	- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
302	- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
303	- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
304	- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
305	- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
306	- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。
307	
308	### 文件系统和路径
309	
310	- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
311	- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
312	- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
313	- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
314	- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。

# Subagent-Driven Development

Execute plan by dispatching a fresh implementer subagent per task, a task review (spec compliance + code quality) after each, and a broad whole-branch review at the end.

**Why subagents:** You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.

**Core principle:** Fresh subagent per task + task review (spec + quality) + broad final review = high quality, fast iteration

**Narration:** between tool calls, narrate at most one short line — the
ledger and the tool results carry the record.

**Continuous execution:** Do not pause to check in with your human partner between tasks. Execute all tasks from the plan without stopping. The only reasons to stop are: BLOCKED status you cannot resolve, ambiguity that genuinely prevents progress, or all tasks complete. "Should I continue?" prompts and progress summaries waste their time — they asked you to execute the plan, so execute it.

## When to Use

}

**vs. Executing Plans (parallel session):**
- Same session (no context switch)
- Fresh subagent per task (no context pollution)
- Review after each task (spec compliance + code quality), broad review at the end
- Faster iteration (no human-in-loop between tasks)

## Setup

Ensure the work happens in an isolated workspace: use
superpowers:using-git-worktrees to create one or verify the existing one.
Never start implementation on a main/master branch without your human
partner's explicit consent.

Conversation memory does not survive compaction. In real sessions,
controllers that lost their place have re-dispatched entire completed task
sequences — the single most expensive failure observed. Track progress in
a ledger file, not only in todos.

- Each plan owns a workspace: at skill start, run this skill's
  `scripts/sdd-workspace PLAN_FILE` — it prints the plan's git-ignored
  directory (`<repo-root>/.superpowers/sdd/<plan-basename>/`), home to
  every artifact for THIS plan: ledger, briefs, reports, review packages.
  Another plan's directory is never yours to read or write.
- Check for this plan's ledger at `<workspace>/progress.md`. If its first
  line names your plan file, tasks with a `Task <N>: complete` line are DONE
  — do not re-dispatch them; resume at the first task without one. A task
  whose last line is a fix round is mid-loop: resume the loop at the next
  round. A ledger whose first line names a different plan file — or a stray
  ledger at the old flat path `.superpowers/sdd/progress.md` — is another
  plan's progress: leave it in place and start your own, fresh.
- Create the ledger with its identity as the first line:
  `# SDD ledger — plan: <plan file path>`.
- The ledger is your recovery map: the commits it names exist in git even
  when your context no longer remembers creating them. After compaction,
  trust the ledger and `git log` over your own recollection.
- `git clean -fdx` will destroy the workspace (it's git-ignored scratch); if
  that happens, recover from `git log`.

Read the plan once, note its context and Global Constraints, and create a
todo per task.

Before dispatching Task 1, scan the plan once for conflicts:

- tasks that contradict each other or the plan's Global Constraints
- anything the plan explicitly mandates that the review rubric treats as a
  defect (a test that asserts nothing, verbatim duplication of a logic block)

Present everything you find to your human partner as one batched question —
each finding beside the plan text that mandates it, asking which governs —
before execution begins, not one interrupt per discovery mid-plan. If the
scan is clean, proceed without comment. The review loop remains the net for
conflicts that only emerge from implementation.

## Model Selection

Use the least powerful model that can handle each role to conserve cost and increase speed.

**Mechanical implementation tasks** (isolated functions, clear specs, 1-2 files): use a fast, cheap model. Most implementation tasks are mechanical when the plan is well-specified.

**Integration and judgment tasks** (multi-file coordination, pattern matching, debugging): use a standard model.

**Architecture and design tasks**: use the most capable available model.
The final whole-branch review is one of these — dispatch it on the most
capable available model, not the session default.

**Review tasks**: choose the model with the same judgment, scaled to the
diff's size, complexity, and risk. A small mechanical diff does not need the
most capable model; a subtle concurrency change does. Scoped re-reviews of
small fix diffs take a cheap-to-mid tier.

**Fix-loop escalation (rounds 4-5)**: use a model at least one tier above
the implementer that got stuck.

**Always specify the model explicitly when dispatching a subagent.** An
omitted model inherits your session's model — often the most capable and
most expensive — which silently defeats this section.

**Turn count beats token price.** Wall-clock and context cost scale with how
many turns a subagent takes, and the cheapest models routinely take 2-3× the
turns on multi-step work — costing more overall. Use a mid-tier model as the
floor for reviewers and for implementers working from prose descriptions.
When the task's plan text contains the complete code to write, the
implementation is transcription plus testing: use the cheapest tier for
that implementer. Single-file mechanical fixes also take the cheapest tier.

**Task complexity signals (implementation tasks):**
- Touches 1-2 files with a complete spec → cheap model
- Touches multiple files with integration concerns → standard model
- Requires design judgment or broad codebase understanding → most capable model

## The Task Loop

Everything you paste into a dispatch prompt — and everything a subagent
prints back — stays resident in your context for the rest of the session
and is re-read on every later turn. Hand artifacts over as files.

### 1. Dispatch the implementer

Record BASE (`git rev-parse HEAD`) before dispatching — the review package
and fix-round diffs need it.

- **Task brief:** before dispatching an implementer, run this skill's
  `scripts/task-brief PLAN_FILE N` — it extracts the task's full text to a
  uniquely named file and prints the path. Compose the dispatch so the
  brief stays the single source of
  requirements. Your dispatch should contain: (1) one line on where this
  task fits in the project; (2) the brief path, introduced as "read this
  first — it is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim";
  (3) interfaces and decisions from earlier tasks that the brief cannot
  know; (4) your resolution of any ambiguity you noticed in the brief;
  (5) the report-file path and report contract. Exact values (numbers,
  magic strings, signatures, test cases) appear only in the brief. Never
  make a subagent read the whole plan file.
- **Report file:** name the implementer's report file after the brief
  (brief `…/task-N-brief.md` → report `…/task-N-report.md`) and put it in
  the dispatch prompt. The implementer writes the full report there and
  returns only status, commits, a one-line test summary, and concerns.
- A dispatch prompt describes one task, not the session's history. Do not
  paste accumulated prior-task summaries ("state after Tasks 1-3") into
  later dispatches — a real session's dispatch hit 42k chars of which 99%
  was pasted history. A fresh subagent needs its task, the interfaces it
  touches, and the global constraints. Nothing else.
- If an earlier task parked a finding in the area this task touches, carry
  a pointer to that ledger entry in the dispatch.
- Record the implementer's agent identity from the dispatch result —
  fix-loop rounds 1-3 resume this agent.
- Never dispatch multiple implementation subagents in parallel (conflicts).

Template: [implementer-prompt.md](implementer-prompt.md)

### 2. Handle the report

Implementer subagents report one of four statuses. Handle each appropriately:

**DONE:** Generate the review package (`scripts/review-package PLAN_FILE BASE HEAD`, from this skill's directory — it prints the unique file path it wrote; BASE is the commit you recorded before dispatching the implementer — never `HEAD~1`, which silently drops all but the last commit of a multi-commit task), then dispatch the task reviewer with the printed path.

**DONE_WITH_CONCERNS:** The implementer completed the work but flagged doubts. Read the concerns before proceeding. If the concerns are about correctness or scope, address them before review. If they're observations (e.g., "this file is getting large"), note them and proceed to review.

**NEEDS_CONTEXT:** The implementer needs information that wasn't provided. Provide the missing context and re-dispatch.

**BLOCKED:** The imp

Things3 数据库接口\n46\twatchdog>=2.1.0         # 文件系统监听\n47\tpython-dotenv>=0.19.0   # 环境配置管理\n48\t```\n49\t\n50\t### System Integration\n51\t- **launchd**: macOS 后台服务守护进程\n52\t- **Things3 数据库路径**: `~/Library/Group Containers/JLMPQHK86H.com.culturedcode.ThingsMac/Things Database.thingsdatabase/main.sqlite`\n53\t\n54\t---\n55\t\n56\t## Directory Structure & Conventions\n57\t\n58\t### Project Structure\n59\t```\n60\tthings3-github-sync/\n61\t├── .env                      # Output:

```
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
```

### Git 和分支

- 当前在 `main`，不要擅自新建嵌套 worktree，也不要切换到旧实现 worktree。
- 不要 `git reset --hard`、rebase、amend、force push、删除分支或清理工作区。
- 不要使用 `git clean -fdx`，尤其不能清理 `.superpowers/sdd/`、`.claude/worktrees/` 或 `.DS_Store`。
- 不要使用 `git add .` 或不带明确路径的 commit。
- 不要把无关的 `.gitignore`、`docs/CHANGELOG.md`、`.DS_Store`、HANDOFF 文件或 nested worktree 状态带入功能提交。
- 不要把 `HEAD~1` 当 task review BASE；必须使用实际 dispatch 前记录的 BASE。
- 未经用户明确要求，不要 push、创建 PR、修改远程或加载 launchd。

### SDD 流程

- implementer 自测不是正式 review；正式 review 必须分别给出规格合规和代码质量 verdict。
- reviewer 的 Critical/Important finding 必须进入修复循环；controller 不直接修改相关实现。
- 修复后必须重新生成 scoped package 和独立复审，不能因改动很小而跳过。
- Minor finding 不能静默丢弃；应记录为 deferred 或修复。
- review agent 失败后不要虚构结论；重新派发并记录真实原因。
- 未完成 Task 7 review 前不能开始 Task 8。

### Things3 只读边界

- 业务代码只能通过 `things.py` 的窄读取接口访问 Things。
- 不要读取/写入 Things SQLite 私有 schema。
- 不要导入或调用 `complete()`、`url()` mutation helper。
- 不要构造 `update`、`update-project` 或其他写入 URL。
- 不要把 `things.py` 文档中的 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 当作公共类。
- 不要把 `trashed` 自动映射为 canceled。
- 不要输出公开 API 无法可靠提供的 priority、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
- Today 必须复用 `things.today()` 语义；不能只根据 `start` 字段自行重建。
- 完整快照读取成功之前，不得修改目标仓库或运行 Git。

### 文件系统和路径

- 生产文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`。
- 写文件必须使用同目录临时文件、flush、fsync、`os.replace()`；失败时保留原文件。
- 任何 desired destination、祖先、manifest destination 在写入前都要做 ownership preflight。
- 绝不能替换未标记陌生文件或符号链接；悬空符号链接也算已存在的 unowned entry。
- manifest 必须严格按 version 1 schema 校验；坏 JSON、坏 UTF-8、错误类型、未知字段、危险路径都要在任何写入前失败。
- 只删除 marker/manifest 明确管理的文件；陌生文件必须保留并 warning。
- 归档不能递归移动含陌生文件的整个目录；只处理已管理文件。
- 路径必须是相对路径，禁止绝对路径和 `..`；本项目路径语义明确采用 macOS/POSIX，标题反斜杠是普通字符。
- `Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于普通当前文件 stale deletion 集合。

### Git 实现

- 生产同步必须用临时 `GIT_INDEX_FILE`，不能把用户原有 staged 文件带进同步提交。
- 只使用明确 pathspec，不要 `git add .`。
- Git 命令必须有 timeout、捕获 stderr，日志中的 URL userinfo/token/auth-token/password 必须脱敏。
- 推送失败不能自动 pull、merge、rebase 或处理冲突。
- 只根据 `refs/things3-sync/pending-push` 判断同步器待推送提交，不要因为分支一般领先远端就推送用户自己的提交。
- 不要对真实远端执行 push。

### 测试和环境

- 优先使用 `/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python`，系统 Python 可能没有 pytest。
- 推荐命令：

```bash
/tmp/things3-task3-venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -v
```

- 如果执行根目录 broad `pytest`，可能误收集被忽略的 `things.py/tests`，出现 `ModuleNotFoundError: tests.test_things`；这不是项目 `tests/` 套件失败。报告中要区分两者。
- 测试时避免产生不必要的 bytecode/cache；可用 `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider ...`。
- 每次任务的报告要记录 RED/GREEN 命令、精确输出和未执行的检查。

## 7. 继续开发的启动步骤

新对话应按以下顺序操作：

278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302	
303	## 配置与部署
304

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True

129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):

131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()

143	                self._timer = None

179	        try:

186	        if not parent.is_dir():

188

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]

+import threading
+from pathlib import Path

+
+import pytest

+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync

+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0

+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
