+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from src.watcher import DatabaseEventFilter, DatabaseWatcher, DebouncedSync
+
+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])
+def test_filter_accepts_database_wal_and_shm_for_each_event_type(tmp_path, method):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_filter_accepts_moved_source_or_destination_and_normalizes_paths(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(database, notify)
+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):
+    notify = Mock()
+    handler = DatabaseEventFilter(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", notify)
+
+    handler.on_modified(event(tmp_path / "other.sqlite"))
+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+
+
+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=True)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 2.0, timer_factory=timers)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    first = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending
+
+
+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+    request = Mock(side_effect=lambda: (entered.set(), release.wait(2), True)[-1])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+    release.set()
+    worker.join(1)
+
+    assert not worker.is_alive()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    assert not timers.instances[1].cancelled
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_false_request_schedules_exactly_one_retry(timers):
+    request = Mock(return_value=False)
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[0].fire()
+
+    assert request.call_count == 1
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 2
+    timers.instances[1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 3
+
+
+def test_callback_exception_is_logged_and_later_notification_works(timers, caplog):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=[RuntimeError("broken"), True])
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        timers.instances[0].fire()
+    assert "Debounced sync request failed" in caplog.text
+
+    debounce.notify()
+    timers.instances[-1].fire()
+    assert request.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_stop_cancels_timer_rejects_notifications_and_waits_for_callback(timers):
+    entered = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def request():
+        entered.set()
+        release.wait(2)
+        return True
+
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    pending = timers.instances[0]
+    debounce.stop()
+    assert pending.cancelled
+    debounce.notify()
+    assert len(timers.instances) == 1
+
+    # A callback already executing is allowed to finish before stop returns.
+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)
+    debounce.notify()
+    worker = threading.Thread(target=timers.instances[-1].fire)
+    worker.start()
+    assert entered.wait(1)
+    stopped = threading.Event()
+    stopper = threading.Thread(target=lambda: (debounce.stop(), stopped.set()))
+    stopper.start()
+    assert not stopped.wait(0.05)
+    release.set()
+    stopper.join(1)
+    worker.join(1)
+    assert stopped.is_set()
+
+
+def test_delay_must_be_positive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), 0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
+        DebouncedSync(Mock(), -1)
+
+
+class FakeObserver:
+    def __init__(self, alive=False):
+        self.alive = alive
+        self.scheduled = []
+        self.started = False
+        self.stopped = False
+        self.join_timeouts = []
+
+    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
+        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+
+    def join(self, timeout=None):
+        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.alive
+
+
+def test_watcher_observer_lifecycle_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    database = tmp_path / "main.sqlite"
+    debounce = Mock()
+    observer = FakeObserver()
+    factory = Mock(return_value=observer)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(database, debounce, observer_factory=factory)
+
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.start()
+    watcher.stop()
+    watcher.stop()
+
+    assert factory.call_count == 1
+    assert observer.started
+    assert observer.stopped
+    assert observer.join_timeouts == [10]
+    assert len(observer.scheduled) == 1
+    handler, path, recursive = observer.scheduled[0]
+    assert path == str(tmp_path)
+    assert recursive is False
+    handler.on_modified(event(database))
+    debounce.notify.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_watcher_requires_existing_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(
+        tmp_path / "missing" / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_rejects_regular_file_as_database_parent(tmp_path):
+    parent = tmp_path / "not-a-directory"
+    parent.write_text("not a directory")
+    observer_factory = Mock()
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(parent / "main.sqlite", Mock(), observer_factory=observer_factory)
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="Database directory"):
+        watcher.start()
+    observer_factory.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_watcher_cleans_up_observer_when_start_fails(tmp_path):
+    startup_error = RuntimeError("observer startup failed")
+    observer = Mock()
+    observer.start.side_effect = startup_error
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="observer startup failed") as raised:
+        watcher.start()
+
+    assert raised.value is startup_error
+    observer.stop.assert_called_once_with()
+    observer.join.assert_called_once_with(timeout=10)
+
+
+    observer = FakeObserver(alive=True)
+    watcher = DatabaseWatcher(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", Mock(), lambda: observer)
+    watcher.start()
+    with caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
+        watcher.stop()
+    assert "did not stop" in caplog.text

@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }
39	
40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45	
46	    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
48	
49	    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51

53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54

59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152

154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
167	        self._observer = None
168	        self._started = False
169	        self._starting = False
170	        self._stopping = False
171	        self._stop_requested = False
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
175	        try:
176	            observer.stop()
177	        except Exception:
178	            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
179	        try:
180	            observer.join(timeout=10)
181	        except Exception:
182	            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
183	
184	    def start(self) -> None:
185	        parent = self._database_path.parent
186	        if not parent.is_dir():
187	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
188	
189	        with self._condition:
190	            while self._starting or self._stopping:
191	                self._condition.wait()
192	            if self._started:
193	                return
194	            self._starting = True
195	            self._stop_requested = False
196	
197	        observer = None
198	        try:
199	            observer = self._observer_factory()
200	            with self._condition:
201	                self._observer = observer
202	            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
203	            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
204	            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
205	            observer.start()
206	        except Exception:
207	            if observer is not None:
208	                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
209	            with self._condition:
210	                if self._observer is observer:
211	                    self._observer = None
212	                self._started = False
213	                self._starting = False
214	                self._stop_requested = False
215	                self._condition.notify_all()
216	            raise
217	
218	        with self._condition:
219	            self._started = True
220	            self._starting = False
221	            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
222	            self._condition.notify_all()
223	
224	        if stop_requested:
225	            self.stop()
226	
227	    def stop(self) -> None:
228	        with self._condition:
229	            if self._starting:
230	                self._stop_requested = True
231	                while self._starting:
232	                    self._condition.wait()
233	            while self._stopping:
234	                self._condition.wait()
235	                if not self._started:
236	                    return
237	            if not self._started:
238	                return
239	            observer = self._observer
240	            self._stopping = True
241	
242	        errors = []
243	        try:
244	            try:
245	                observer.stop()
246	            except Exception as exc:
247	                errors.append(exc)
248	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
249	            try:
250	                observer.join(timeout=10)
251	            except Exception as exc:
252	                errors.append(exc)
253	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
254	
255	            alive = False
256	            try:
257	                alive = observer.is_alive()
258	            except Exception as exc:
259	                errors.append(exc)
260	                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
261	            if alive:
262	                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
263	        finally:
264	            with self._condition:
265	                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
266	                if cleanup_succeeded:
267	                    self._started = False
268	                    self._observer = None
269	                    self._stop_requested = False
270	                self._stopping = False
271	                self._condition.notify_all()
272	
273	        if errors:
274	            raise errors[0]

1739	Subclass `watchdog.events.FileSystemEventHandler`. Compare resolved/normalized string paths for the database, `database.name + "-wal"`, and `database.name + "-shm"`. Never read database content in an event callback.
1740	
1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.
1742	
1743	Use daemon timers, but `stop(wait=True)` must wait on the condition until `_running` becomes false. Do not hold the condition while executing the sync callback.

1746	
1747	`DatabaseWatcher.start()` verifies `database_path.parent` exists, schedules one non-recursive watch on that parent, and starts the observer. `stop()` calls `observer.stop()` then `observer.join(timeout=10)`; if still alive, log an error. Starting twice or stopping before start is idempotent.

CONFIRMED

Trigger: Configure `DatabaseEventFilter` with a symlink `main.sqlite -> old.sqlite`, then delete or retarget the symlink and deliver a watchdog event whose `src_path` is `main.sqlite`. The filter resolves the event after the link has changed, while `_paths` retains the original target path, so the callback is skipped. Direct reproduction produced `0` callbacks for both retarget and unlink cases. Stable target-file deletion still produced one callback.

Quoted lines from `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/watcher.py`:

- `return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()`
- `database = _normalize_path(database_path)`
- `self._paths: Set[Path] = {`
- `if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):`
- `self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)`
- `parent = self._database_path.parent`
- `observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)`

Task 9’s resolved-path requirement is satisfied for stable symlink targets, but symlink replacement/deletion creates a concrete missed-event case when the alias event is delivered from the watched parent. The full pytest suite was unavailable because `pytest` is not installed; the targeted behavior was reproduced directly without editing.

result: CONFIRMED — symlink deletion or retargeting can make DatabaseEventFilter miss the configured database event.

23	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):

26	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
27	        super().__init__()
28	        database = Path(database_path).expanduser().resolve()
29	        self._request_sync = request_sync

38	        if not path:

43	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):

45	        if any(self._normalized(path) in self._paths for path in paths):

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()
154

156	class DatabaseWatcher:
157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,
162	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False
170	
171	    def start(self) -> None:
172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:
181	            observer.start()
182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:
185	                observer.stop()
186	            except Exception:
187	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
188	            try:
189	                observer.join(timeout=10)
190	            except Exception:
191	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
192	            raise
193	        self._observer = observer
194	        self._started = True
195	
196	    def stop(self) -> None:
197	        if not self._started:
198	            return
199	        observer = self._observer
200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
203	        observer.join(timeout=10)
204	        if observer.is_alive():
205	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

1740	
1741	`DebouncedSync` uses one `threading.Condition` and state fields `_timer`, `_running`, `_pending`, `_stopped`. `notify()` marks pending and resets a timer when not running; if running, it only marks pending. Timer fire clears `_timer`, marks running, calls `request()` outside the condition, then marks not running. It schedules one new timer when pending was set or request returned false. Catch callback exceptions, log them, and permit later notifications.

 class SyncEngine:
     def __init__(
         self,
         config,
         reader: SnapshotReader,
         git_client: GitSyncClient,
         renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
         reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
     ) -> None:
         self.config = config
         self.reader = reader
         self.git_client = git_client
         self.renderer = renderer
         self.reconciler = reconciler
         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 
     def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
         status["stage"] = "reader"
         snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
         status["stage"] = "renderer"
         rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
         status["stage"] = "reconciler"
         changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
         status["changes"] = changes
         status["stage"] = "git"
         committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
             changes,
             auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
             auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
             remote=self.config.git_remote,
             branch=self.config.git_branch,
         )
         status["committed"] = committed
         status["pushed"] = pushed
         return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
 
     @staticmethod
     def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
         try:
             changes = status["changes"]
             counts = (
                 (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
                 if changes is not None
                 else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
             )
             committed = status["committed"]
             pushed = status["pushed"]
             if committed is None:
                 committed = "not executed"
             if pushed is None:
                 pushed = "not executed"
             duration = time.monotonic() - started
             error = status["error"]
             if error is None:
                 _LOG.info(
                     "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
                 )
             else:
                 _LOG.error(
-                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=%r",
+                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
                     status["stage"],
                     duration,
                     counts[0],
                     counts[1],
                     counts[2],
                     committed,
                     pushed,
-                    error,
                 )
         except BaseException:
             # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
             pass
 
     def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
         status = {
             "stage": "reader",
             "changes": None,
             "committed": None,
             "pushed": None,
             "error": None,
         }
         try:
             return self._sync_locked(status)
         except BaseException as error:
             status["error"] = error
             raise
         finally:
             try:
                 self._log_sync(started, status)
             finally:
                 self._lock.release()
 
     def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
         started = time.monotonic()
         self._lock.acquire()
         return self._run_locked(started)
 
     def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
         started = time.monotonic()
         if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
             return False
         self._run_locked(started)
         return True

150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
```

</details>

46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True

from .utils import parse_bool

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppConfig:
    repo_path: Path
    things_db: Optional[Path] = None
    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_max_bytes: int = 10_485_760
    log_backup_count: int = 5
    watch_debounce_seconds: float = 2.0
    full_sync_interval: float = 3600.0

    auto_push: bool = True
    git_remote: str = "origin"
    git_branch: str = "main"
    git_timeout_seconds: float = 30.0

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, *, git_runner: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess] = subprocess.run) -> "AppConfig":
        values = os.environ if env is None else env
        raw_repo = values.get("REPO_PATH", "").strip()
        if not raw_repo: raise ValueError("REPO_PATH is required")
        repo = Path(raw_repo).expanduser().resolve()
        if not repo.exists() or not repo.is_dir(): raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be an existing directory: {repo}")
        def number(name, default, cast=float, positive=False, nonnegative=False):
            try: result = cast(values.get(name, str(default)))
            except (TypeError, ValueError): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be numeric")
            if positive and result <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
            if nonnegative and result < 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
            return result
        timeout = number("GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 30.0, float, positive=True)
        level = values.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO").strip().upper()
        if level not in {"DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"}: raise ValueError(f"Unsupported log level: {level}")
        auto_commit = parse_bool("AUTO_COMMIT", values.get("AUTO_COMMIT", "true"))
        auto_push = parse_bool("AUTO_PUSH", values.get("AUTO_PUSH", "true"))
        if auto_push and not auto_commit: raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
        result = git_runner(["git", "rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0 or result.stdout.strip() != "true": raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be a Git work tree: {repo}")
        branch_result = git_runner(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
        branch = branch_result.stdout.strip()
        configured_branch = values.get("GIT_BRANCH", "main").strip()
        if not branch: raise ValueError("GIT_BRANCH cannot be used with detached HEAD")
        if branch != configured_branch: raise ValueError(f"GIT_BRANCH {configured_branch} does not match checked-out branch {branch}")
        things = values.get("THINGSDB", "").strip()
        return cls(repo, Path(things).expanduser().resolve() if things else None, level, number("LOG_MAX_BYTES", 10485760, int, positive=True), number("LOG_BACKUP_COUNT", 5, int, nonnegative=True), number("WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS", 2.0, float, positive=True), number("FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL", 3600.0, float, positive=True), auto_commit, auto_push, values.get("GIT_REMOTE", "origin"), configured_branch, timeout)

1. **`PLAUSIBLE`**: `_schedule_locked()` starts the timer while its caller holds the condition.
   - `notify()` holds the condition at lines 104-111, and `_schedule_locked()` calls `timer.start()` at lines 95-101.
   - The default `threading.Timer` starts another thread and returns immediately. If that thread runs at once, `_fire()` blocks at line 114 until the caller releases the condition, so there is no default-production deadlock.
   - A custom timer whose `start()` launches the callback and waits for it can deadlock: the callback blocks acquiring the condition at line 114 while `start()` waits, and the caller cannot release the condition until `start()` returns. A same-thread synchronous timer re-enters instead; because `Condition()` uses an `RLock`, it does not deadlock immediately, but the request executes inside the outer critical section. A continuously false request can recursively reschedule.
   - Therefore this is a valid injected/custom-factory hazard, but not a demonstrated risk with the default timer.

2. **`REFUTED`**: `stop(wait=True)` does not have the proposed missed-start race.
   - `_fire()` acquires the condition and sets `_running = True` before invoking the callback at lines 113-120.

     - If `_fire()` gets the lock first, `stop()` observes `_running = True` and waits in lines 150-153.

Output:

```
REFUTED — Trigger: `stop(wait=True)` sets `_stopped = True` before waiting, so `_fire()` cannot enter the failing reschedule branch. The relevant lines are:

- `"self._stopped = True"` at line 139
- `"if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):"` at line 129
- `"self._schedule_locked()"` at line 131
- `"self._condition.notify_all()"` at line 132
- `"while self._running:"` at line 150

A concurrent `stop(wait=True)` already waiting means `_stopped` is true, so `_schedule_locked()` is skipped and `notify_all()` executes. If `timer_factory` raises while `_stopped` is false, `stop()` has not yet begun waiting; once the lock is released, it observes `_running` as false. Existing tests cover callback exceptions and stop waiting, but not a raising `timer_factory`; that omission does not make this specific deadlock interleaving real.

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152

155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise

192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:

197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()

    66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
    67	
    68	    def __init__(
    69	        self,

    76	        self._request = request

    83	        self._stopped = False

    94	        self._generation += 1
    95	        generation = self._generation

    97	        timer.daemon = True

   105	            self._pending = True
   106	            if not self._running:

   115	            self._timer = None
   116	            self._pending = False
   117	            self._running = True
   118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()

   156

   172	        parent = self._database_path.parent

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        if self._started:
+            return
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+        observer = self._observer_factory()
+        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+        try:
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self._observer = None
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception:
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+            raise
+        self._observer = observer
+        self._started = True
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if not self._started:
+            return
+        observer = self._observer
+        self._started = False
+        self._observer = None
+        observer.stop()
+        observer.join(timeout=10)
+        if observer.is_alive():
+            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

+

+
+def event(path, dest=None, is_directory=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        src_path=str(path),
+        dest_path=str(dest) if dest else "",
+        is_directory=is_directory,
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["on_modified", "on_created", "on_deleted"])

+
+    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
+        getattr(handler, method)(event(Path(f"{database}{suffix}")))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 3
+
+

+
+    handler.on_moved(event(database, tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "elsewhere", database / "../main.sqlite-wal"))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_filter_ignores_unrelated_and_directory_events(tmp_path):

+

+    handler.on_created(event(tmp_path, is_directory=True))
+    handler.on_moved(event(tmp_path / "main.sqlite", tmp_path / "other", True))
+
+    assert notify.call_count == 0
+
+
+class FakeTimer:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, delay, callback):
+        self.delay = delay
+        self.callback = callback
+        self.started = False
+        self.cancelled = False
+        type(self).instances.append(self)
+
+    @property
+    def daemon(self):
+        return getattr(self, "_daemon", None)
+
+    @daemon.setter
+    def daemon(self, value):
+        self._daemon = value
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started = True
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.cancelled = True
+
+    def fire(self):
+        self.callback()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reset(cls):
+        cls.instances.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def timers():
+    FakeTimer.reset()
+    yield FakeTimer
+    FakeTimer.reset()

+def test_debounce_uses_trailing_edge_timer(timers):

+
+    debounce.notify()

+    debounce.notify()
+    second = timers.instances[-1]
+    debounce.notify()
+    third = timers.instances[-1]
+
+    assert [timer.cancelled for timer in (first, second, third)] == [True, True, False]
+    assert third.delay == 2.0
+    assert all(timer.daemon for timer in timers.instances)
+    third.fire()
+    request.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert not debounce._pending

+def test_notification_during_request_schedules_one_later_timer(timers):

+    release = threading.Event()

+    debounce = DebouncedSync(request, 1.0, timer_factory=timers)

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()

160	        self,

188	            try:

192	            raise

202	        observer.stop()

199	class FakeObserver:
200	    def __init__(self, alive=False):
201	        self.alive = alive
202	        self.scheduled = []
203	        self.started = False
204	        self.stopped = False
205	        self.join_timeouts = []
206	
207	    def schedule(self, handler, path, recursive):
208	        self.scheduled.append((handler, path, recursive))
209	
210	    def start(self):
211	        self.started = True
212	
213	    def stop(self):
214	        self.stopped = True
215	
216	    def join(self, timeout=None):
217	        self.join_timeouts.append(timeout)
218	
219	    def is_alive(self):
220	        return self.alive
221

```
1	# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP 设计
2	
3	## 背景
4	
5	本项目需要在 macOS 上只读监听 Things3 数据库，将任务导出为结构化 Markdown，并通过 Git 自动提交和推送到用户已配置的远端仓库。
6	
7	仓库中的 `Agent.md` 描述了完整产品愿景，但当前主项目尚无实现。内嵌的 `things.py` 1.0.1 参考库公开的是返回稀疏字典的函数接口，而不是 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 类；它也不提供优先级、Evening 等字段。因此 MVP 以参考库的真实只读数据为准，不输出无法可靠获得的字段。
8	
9	## 目标
10	
11	MVP 必须做到：
12	
13	1. 启动时读取完整 Things3 快照并同步 Markdown。
14	2. 监听 Things3 SQLite 数据库及其 WAL/SHM 变化，经防抖后再次同步。
15	3. 使用确定性渲染和原子文件替换，使内容未变化时不写磁盘、不产生 Git diff。
16	4. 自动暂存同步器实际变更的明确路径，按配置提交并推送。
17	5. 定时运行同一套完整快照同步，修复遗漏或漂移。
18	6. 捕获 `SIGINT` 和 `SIGTERM`，停止接收新工作并等待当前同步结束。
19	7. 提供安装、配置、前台运行与 launchd 部署文档和自动化测试。
20	
21	## 非目标
22	
23	MVP 不包括：
24	
25	- 从 Markdown 写回 Things3。
26	- Things 附件同步。
27	- 自动 merge、rebase 或解决 Git 冲突。
28	- 从底层数据库私有字段推导 `things.py` 未公开的优先级、Evening 或重复规则。
29	- Web 管理界面和性能监控面板。
30	- 对真实 GitHub 远端或真实用户 Things 数据库执行自动化集成测试。
31	
32	## 关键决策
33	
34	### 同步策略
35	
36	采用“防抖后的确定性完整快照”策略，而不是在 MVP 中维护独立的增量写入路径。
37	
38	每次同步均执行：
39	
40	```text
41	读取完整只读快照
42	  -> 规范化数据
43	  -> 渲染期望文件集合
44	  -> 原子协调磁盘
45	  -> 明确暂存变更路径
46	  -> 可选提交
47	  -> 可选推送
48	```
49	
50	SQLite 文件变化事件无法直接指出发生变化的任务。即使做 UUID 级增量更新，也必须先读取新快照做差异比较。完整快照渲染可同时正确处理任务移动、删除、容器重命名和 Today/Upcoming 派生视图，并让启动同步、监听同步和定时校验复用同一条代码路径。
51	
52	完整快照不意味着无条件重写文件。文件协调器先比较字节内容，只替换发生变化的文件。由此，单个标题变化通常只产生对应标题行的 Git diff。
53	
54	### 文件所有权
55	
56	同步器完全管理它生成的 Markdown 内容，但删除操作采用保守边界：
57	
58	- 每个生成文件包含稳定的生成标识。
59	- 仅删除位于已知导出路径中、带生成标识且不再属于期望快照的文件。
60	- 未带生成标识的陌生文件始终保留并记录警告。
61	- 同步器不使用笼统的目录递归删除处理未知内容。
62	
63	该规则兼顾确定性全量协调和用户文件保护。
64	
65	### 主位置与派生视图
66	
67	每个任务只有一个主位置，优先级如下：
68	
69	1. 所属 Project。
70	2. 所属 Area。
71	3. `Inbox`、`Anytime` 或 `Someday` 顶层列表。
72	
73	`Today.md` 和 `Upcoming.md` 是派生视图，允许重复展示已有主位置的任务。Today 的语义直接复用 `things.today()`，不根据单一 `start` 字段自行重建。
74	
75	## 架构
76	
77	### `src/config.py`
78	
79	负责读取和验证 `.env` 配置，向其他模块提供类型化配置对象。配置包括：
80	
81	- `REPO_PATH`：目标 Git 仓库绝对路径。
82	- `THINGSDB`：可选数据库覆盖路径；缺省时使用 `things.py` 自带的路径发现。
83	- `LOG_LEVEL`、`LOG_MAX_BYTES`、`LOG_BACKUP_COUNT`。
84	- `WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS`。
85	- `FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL`。
86	- `AUTO_COMMIT`、`AUTO_PUSH`。
87	- `GIT_REMOTE`、`GIT_BRANCH`。
88	- Git 子进程超时。
89	
90	约束：`AUTO_PUSH=true` 时必须启用 `AUTO_COMMIT`。目标路径必须存在且为 Git 工作树。敏感配置不写入日志。
91	
92	### `src/models.py`
93	
94	定义项目内部不可变数据模型，将外部稀疏字典与渲染逻辑隔离。主要实体为：
95	
96	- `TaskSnapshot`
97	- `ChecklistItem`
98	- `ContainerSnapshot`
99	- `ThingsSnapshot`
100	
101	可选字段有明确的 `None` 或空集合默认值。状态只接受 `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled`；类型只接受 MVP 用到的 `to-do`、`project`、`heading`。
102	
103	### `src/things_adapter.py`
104	
105	只使用 `things` 的读取接口：`tasks()`、`areas()`、`today()`、`upcoming()` 等，并把结果规范化为内部模型。
106	
107	该模块不导入或调用 `complete()`，也不构造 `update`/`update-project` URL。数据库访问失败后等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次。只有读取并规范化完整快照成功后才向调用方返回结果。
108	
109	数据库定位遵循：
110	
111	1. 显式 `THINGSDB`。
112	2. `things.py` 对现代 `ThingsData-*` 路径的发现。
113	3. 参考库的旧路径回退。
114	
115	### `src/renderer.py`
116	
117	输入一个 `ThingsSnapshot`，输出 `dict[Path, str]`，键是相对于目标仓库的安全路径，值是确定性 UTF-8 Markdown 内容。
118	
119	职责包括：
120	
121	- 分配任务主位置和终态文件。
122	- 构造 Today/Upcoming 派生视图。
123	- 对任务进行稳定排序。
124	- 渲染任务区块、UUID 注释、元数据和 checklist。
125	- 清理文件名并解决路径冲突。
126	- 转义会破坏 Markdown 结构的单行内容。
127	
128	该模块不读取或写入文件，也不执行 Git。
129	
130	### `src/filesystem.py`
131	
132	协调期望文件集合与目标仓库当前状态：
133	
134	- 内容相同的文件不写入。
135	- 新内容先写入目标文件同目录下的临时文件，刷新后使用 `os.replace()` 原子替换。
136	- 删除不再存在的旧托管文件。
137	- 保留所有陌生文件。
138	- 返回新增、修改、删除的明确相对路径集合，供 Git 层使用。
139	
140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302

308	- `requirements.txt`
309	- `setup.py` 交互式配置脚本
310	- `generate_launchd.py`

1	"""Coordinate one snapshot-to-Git synchronization transaction."""
2	
3	import logging
4	import threading
5	import time
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Callable, Protocol, Tuple
8	
9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
