101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:

146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:

68	def _read_manifest_mapping(repo_path: Path, value: object, name: str) -> Mapping[str, Path]:
69	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
70	        raise ValueError("manifest {} must be an object".format(name))
71	    result = {}
72	    for key, path in value.items():
73	        if type(key) is not str or not key or type(path) is not str:
74	            raise ValueError("manifest {} has invalid entry".format(name))
75	        relative_path = Path(path)
76	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_path)
77	        result[key] = relative_path
78	    return result

81	def load_manifest(repo_path: Path) -> Manifest:
82	    """Safely load the current repository manifest without modifying disk."""
83	    repo_path = Path(repo_path)
84	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
85	    if not manifest_path.exists():
86	        return _empty_manifest()
87	    try:
88	        with manifest_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as manifest_file:
89	            data = json.load(manifest_file)
90	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
91	        raise ValueError("invalid sync manifest") from error
92	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
93	        raise ValueError("manifest must be an object")
94	    expected_keys = {
95	        "_generated_by",
96	        "version",
97	        "managed_files",
98	        "active_containers",
99	        "archived_containers",
100	    }
101	    if set(data) != expected_keys:
102	        raise ValueError("manifest does not match the version 1 schema")
103	    if data.get("_generated_by") != _MANIFEST_GENERATOR:
104	        raise ValueError("manifest has an invalid generator marker")
105	    if type(data.get("version")) is not int or data["version"] != _MANIFEST_VERSION:
106	        raise ValueError("manifest has an unsupported version")
107	    managed_files = data.get("managed_files")
108	    if not isinstance(managed_files, list) or not all(type(path) is str for path in managed_files):

110	    paths = tuple(Path(path) for path in managed_files)
111	    if len(paths) != len(set(paths)):
112	        raise ValueError("manifest managed_files contains duplicates")
113	    for path in paths:

124	def _manifest_content(manifest: Manifest) -> str:
125	    data = {
126	        "_generated_by": _MANIFEST_GENERATOR,
127	        "version": manifest.version,
128	        "managed_files": [path.as_posix() for path in manifest.managed_files],
129	        "active_containers": {
130	            key: path.as_posix() for key, path in manifest.active_containers.items()
131	        },
132	        "archived_containers": {
133	            key: path.as_posix() for key, path in manifest.archived_containers.items()
134	        },
135	    }
136	    return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"

139	def _atomic_write(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
140	    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
141	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
142	    temporary_path = None
143	    try:
144	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
145	            mode="w",
146	            encoding="utf-8",
147	            newline="\n",
148	            dir=path.parent,
149	            prefix=".{}.".format(path.name),
150	            suffix=".tmp",
151	            delete=False,
152	        ) as temporary_file:
153	            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
154	            temporary_file.write(content)
155	            temporary_file.flush()
156	            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())
157	        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
158	    finally:
159	        if temporary_path is not None:
160	            try:
161	                temporary_path.unlink()
162	            except FileNotFoundError:
163	                pass

170	def _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path: Path, containers: Mapping[str, Path]) -> None:

173	    for relative_dir in set(containers.values()):
174	        current = repo_path / relative_dir

179	                _LOG.warning("Not removing nonempty container directory: %s", relative_dir)
180	                break
181	            current = current.parent
182	        if current.resolve() == root:
183	            continue

193	            raise ValueError("duplicate container identity: {}".format(key))

198	def _archive_uuid_suffix(uuid: str) -> str:
199	    sanitized = "".join(character if character.isalnum() else "-" for character in uuid)
200	    if any(character.isalnum() for character in sanitized):
201	        return sanitized[:8]
202	    return hashlib.sha256(uuid.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]

205	def _archive_directory(key: str, active_dir: Path) -> Path:

208	    try:

210	    except KeyError as error:

212	    return Path("Archived") / archive_root / "{}-{}".format(active_dir.name, _archive_uuid_suffix(uuid))

223	def _preflight_manifest_destination(repo_path: Path) -> None:
224	    """Reject non-regular manifest entries without following symlinks."""
225	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
226	    if not os.path.lexists(str(manifest_path)):
227	        return
228	    if manifest_path.is_symlink() or not manifest_path.is_file():
229	        raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(MANIFEST_PATH))

232	def _preflight_destination(repo_path: Path, relative_path: Path, previous: Manifest) -> None:
233	    """Ensure every existing destination component is safe before writes begin."""
234	    destination = repo_path / relative_path
235	    current = repo_path
236	    for component in relative_path.parts:
237	        current = current / component
238	        if not os.path.lexists(str(current)):
239	            continue
240	        if current.is_symlink():
241	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
242	        if current == destination:
243	            if not current.is_file():
244	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
245	            if relative_path in previous.managed_files:
246	                return
247	            try:
248	                managed = is_managed_markdown(_read_text(current))
249	            except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
250	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path)) from error
251	            if not managed:
252	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
253	            return
254	        if not current.is_dir():
255	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
256	
257	
258	def _preflight_archive_destination(repo_path: Path, relative_path: Path, previous: Manifest) -> None:
259	    """Require retained archive files to remain marked before overwriting them."""
260	    _preflight_destination(repo_path, relative_path, previous)
261	    destination = repo_path / relative_path
262	    if not destination.exists():
263	        return
264	    try:
265	        marked = destination.is_file() and is_managed_markdown(_read_text(destination))
266	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
267	        raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path)) from error
268	    if not marked:
269	        raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
270

272	def reconcile(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> ChangeSet:
273	    """Reconcile managed files, preserving unowned paths and writing manifest last."""

283	
284	    archived_containers = dict(previous.archived_containers)
285	    archive_moves = []
286	    for key, old_dir in previous.active_containers.items():
287	        if key in active_containers:

289	        archive_dir = archived_containers.get(key, _archive_directory(key, old_dir))
290	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, archive_dir)

292	        for old_path in _managed_paths_in_container(previous.managed_files, old_dir):

8	def parse_bool(name: str, raw: str) -> bool:
9	    value = raw.strip().lower()

12	    raise ValueError(f"{name} must be true or false")

15	    value = _INVALID_PATH_CHARS.sub("-", title).strip().rstrip(".").strip()
16	    value = value or fallback
17	    return value[:max_length].rstrip(".").strip() or fallback[:max_length]

19	def setup_logging(log_dir: Path, level: str, max_bytes: int, backup_count: int) -> None:
20	    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
21	    formatter = logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
22	    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(log_dir / "sync.log", maxBytes=max_bytes, backupCount=backup_count, encoding="utf-8")
23	    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
24	    file_handler.setFormatter(formatter); stream_handler.setFormatter(formatter)

16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):

19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,

34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()

131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135

137	        started = time.monotonic()

47	def discover_database_path(
48	    explicit: Optional[Path] = None, home: Optional[Path] = None
49	) -> Path:
50	    """Find the Things database, preferring an explicitly supplied path."""
51	    if explicit is not None:

55	        return candidate

92	def _normalize_checklist(items: object) -> Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...]:

178	def _rows(value: object) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
179	    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
180	    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
181	        return []
182	    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]

185	def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
186	    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
187	    result: List[str] = []
188	    seen = set()
189	    for row in _rows(value):
190	        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
191	            continue
192	        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
193	        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
194	            seen.add(uuid)
195	            result.append(uuid)
196	    return tuple(result)

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )
275

34	def generate_commit_message(counts: ChangeCounts, now: datetime) -> str:
35	    """Build the stable message used for managed sync commits."""

41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:
48	        return value
49	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))

52	def _redact_credentials(text: str) -> str:
53	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
54	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
55	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

62	def _counts_from_name_status(output: str) -> ChangeCounts:
63	    fields = output.split("\0")
64	    index = 0
65	    added = modified = deleted = 0
66	    while index < len(fields):
67	        status = fields[index]
68	        if not status:
69	            break
70	        index += 1
71	        code = status[0]
72	        if code in _RENAME_OR_COPY:
73	            index += 2
74	        else:
75	            index += 1
76	        if code == "A":
77	            added += 1
78	        elif code == "D":
79	            deleted += 1
80	        else:
81	            modified += 1
82	    return ChangeCounts(added, modified, deleted)

239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:

241	        if not auto_commit:

12	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
13	_ROOT_FILES = (
14	    (Path("Inbox.md"), "Inbox"),
15	    (Path("Today.md"), "Today"),
16	    (Path("Anytime.md"), "Anytime"),
17	    (Path("Someday.md"), "Someday"),
18	    (Path("Upcoming.md"), "Upcoming"),

28	_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH = 120

31	def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
32	    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)
33	
34	
35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:
42	            token.extend("x{:02x}".format(byte) for byte in character.encode("utf-8"))
43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"
44	
45	
46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
54	
55	
56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85	
86	
87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106

108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths

173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))

181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected

235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)

+"""Watch the Things database and schedule serialized, debounced syncs."""
+
+import logging
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, Set, Tuple
+
+try:
+    from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler
+    from watchdog.observers import Observer
+except ImportError:  # Keep imports usable for environments before dependencies are installed.
+    class FileSystemEventHandler:
+        pass
+
+    class Observer:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            raise ImportError("watchdog is required to observe filesystem changes")
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _normalize_path(path: object) -> Path:
+    return Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+
+
+class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
+    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._request_sync = request_sync
+        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
+            database,
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
+            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
+        }
+
+    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
+        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
+            return
+        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
+            self._request_sync()
+
+    def on_modified(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_created(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_deleted(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
+
+    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
+        self._handle(
+            event,
+            (
+                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
+                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class DebouncedSync:
+    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        request: Callable[[], bool],
+        delay: float,
+        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
+    ) -> None:
+        if delay <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
+        self._request = request
+        self._delay = delay
+        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._timer = None
+        self._running = False
+        self._pending = False
+        self._stopped = False
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._callback_thread = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+
+    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
+        self._generation += 1
+        generation = self._generation
+        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
+        timer.daemon = True
+        self._timer = timer
+        timer.start()
+
+    def notify(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                return
+            self._pending = True
+            if not self._running:
+                if self._timer is not None:
+                    self._timer.cancel()
+                self._schedule_locked()
+
+    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
+                return
+            self._timer = None
+            self._pending = False
+            self._running = True
+            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
+
+        retry = False
+        try:
+            retry = not bool(self._request())
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._running = False
+                self._callback_thread = None
+                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
+                    self._pending = False
+                    self._schedule_locked()
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._stopped:
+                running = self._running
+            else:
+                self._stopped = True
+                self._pending = False
+                self._generation += 1
+                timer = self._timer
+                self._timer = None
+                if timer is not None:
+                    timer.cancel()
+                running = self._running
+
+        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
+            with self._condition:
+                while self._running:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+
+
+class DatabaseWatcher:
+    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_path: Path,
+        debounce: DebouncedSync,
+        observer_factory=Observer,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._database_path = _normalize_path(database_path)
+        self._debounce = debounce
+        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
+        self._condition = threading.Condition()
+        self._observer = None
+        self._started = False
+        self._starting = False
+        self._stopping = False
+        self._stop_requested = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cleanup_after_start_failure(observer) -> None:
+        try:
+            observer.stop()
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
+        try:
+            observer.join(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        parent = self._database_path.parent
+        if not parent.is_dir():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
+
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._starting or self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            if self._started:
+                return
+            self._starting = True
+            self._stop_requested = False
+
+        observer = None
+        try:
+            observer = self._observer_factory()
+            with self._condition:
+                self._observer = observer
+            handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
+            # Scheduling is part of startup so a partially configured observer is cleaned up.
+            observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
+            observer.start()
+        except Exception:
+            if observer is not None:
+                self._cleanup_after_start_failure(observer)
+            with self._condition:
+                if self._observer is observer:
+                    self._observer = None
+                self._started = False
+                self._starting = False
+                self._stop_requested = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            self._started = True
+            self._starting = False
+            stop_requested = self._stop_requested
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if stop_requested:
+            self.stop()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._starting:
+                self._stop_requested = True
+                while self._starting:
+                    self._condition.wait()
+            while self._stopping:
+                self._condition.wait()
+                if not self._started:
+                    return
+            if not self._started:
+                return
+            observer = self._observer
+            self._stopping = True
+
+        errors = []
+        try:
+            try:
+                observer.stop()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher")
+            try:
+                observer.join(timeout=10)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher")
+
+            alive = False
+            try:
+                alive = observer.is_alive()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(exc)
+                _LOG.exception("Failed to check database watcher state")
+            if alive:
+                _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")
+        finally:
+            with self._condition:
+                cleanup_succeeded = not errors and not alive
+                if cleanup_succeeded:
+                    self._started = False
+                    self._observer = None
+                    self._stop_requested = False
+                self._stopping = False
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+
+        if errors:
+            raise errors[0]
```

27	class DatabaseEventFilter(FileSystemEventHandler):
28	    """Forward events for the database and SQLite's sidecar files only."""
29	
30	    def __init__(self, database_path: Path, request_sync: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
31	        super().__init__()
32	        database = _normalize_path(database_path)
33	        self._request_sync = request_sync
34	        self._paths: Set[Path] = {
35	            database,
36	            database.with_name(database.name + "-wal"),
37	            database.with_name(database.name + "-shm"),
38	        }

40	    def _handle(self, event, paths: Tuple[object, ...]) -> None:
41	        if getattr(event, "is_directory", False):
42	            return
43	        if any(path and _normalize_path(path) in self._paths for path in paths):
44	            self._request_sync()
45

47	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))

50	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
51

53	        self._handle(event, (getattr(event, "src_path", None),))
54	
55	    def on_moved(self, event) -> None:
56	        self._handle(
57	            event,

59	                getattr(event, "src_path", None),
60	                getattr(event, "dest_path", None),
61	            ),
62	        )

65	class DebouncedSync:
66	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
67	
68	    def __init__(
69	        self,
70	        request: Callable[[], bool],
71	        delay: float,
72	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
73	    ) -> None:
74	        if delay <= 0:
75	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
76	        self._request = request
77	        self._delay = delay
78	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
79	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
80	        self._timer = None
81	        self._running = False
82	        self._pending = False
83	        self._stopped = False
84	        self._generation = 0
85	        self._callback_thread = None
86	
87	    def start(self) -> None:
88	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
89	        with self._condition:
90	            if self._stopped:
91	                return
92	
93	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
94	        self._generation += 1
95	        generation = self._generation
96	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
97	        timer.daemon = True
98	        self._timer = timer
99	        timer.start()
100	
101	    def notify(self) -> None:
102	        with self._condition:
103	            if self._stopped:
104	                return
105	            self._pending = True
106	            if not self._running:
107	                if self._timer is not None:
108	                    self._timer.cancel()
109	                self._schedule_locked()
110	
111	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
112	        with self._condition:
113	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
114	                return
115	            self._timer = None
116	            self._pending = False
117	            self._running = True
118	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
119	
120	        retry = False
121	        try:
122	            retry = not bool(self._request())
123	        except Exception:
124	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
125	        finally:
126	            with self._condition:
127	                self._running = False
128	                self._callback_thread = None
129	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
130	                    self._pending = False
131	                    self._schedule_locked()
132	                self._condition.notify_all()
133	
134	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
135	        with self._condition:
136	            if self._stopped:
137	                running = self._running
138	            else:
139	                self._stopped = True
140	                self._pending = False
141	                self._generation += 1
142	                timer = self._timer
143	                self._timer = None
144	                if timer is not None:
145	                    timer.cancel()
146	                running = self._running
147	
148	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
149	            with self._condition:
150	                while self._running:
151	                    self._condition.wait()
152	
153	
154	class DatabaseWatcher:
155	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
156	
157	    def __init__(
158	        self,
159	        database_path: Path,
160	        debounce: DebouncedSync,
161	        observer_factory=Observer,
162	    ) -> None:
163	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
164	        self._debounce = debounce
165	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
166	        self._observer = None
167	        self._started = False
168	
169	    def start(self) -> None:
170	        if self._started:
171	            return
172	        parent = self._database_path.parent
173	        if not parent.is_dir():
174	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
175	        observer = self._observer_factory()
176	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
177	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
178	        try:
179	            observer.start()
180	        except Exception:
181	            self._observer = None
182	            try:
183	                observer.stop()
184	            except Exception:
185	                _LOG.exception("Failed to stop database watcher after startup failure")
186	            try:
187	                observer.join(timeout=10)
188	            except Exception:
189	                _LOG.exception("Failed to join database watcher after startup failure")
190	            raise
191	        self._observer = observer
192	        self._started = True
193	
194	    def stop(self) -> None:
195	        if not self._started:
196	            return
197	        observer = self._observer
198	        self._started = False
199	        self._observer = None
200	        observer.stop()
201	        observer.join(timeout=10)
202	        if observer.is_alive():
203	            _LOG.error("Database watcher did not stop within 10 seconds")

9	from .filesystem import reconcile
10	from .models import ChangeSet, RenderedSnapshot, SyncResult, ThingsSnapshot
11	from .renderer import render_snapshot
12	
13	
14	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15	
16	
17	class SnapshotReader(Protocol):
18	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
19	        ...
20	
21	
22	class GitSyncClient(Protocol):
23	    def sync(
24	        self,
25	        changes: ChangeSet,
26	        auto_commit: bool,
27	        auto_push: bool,
28	        remote: str,
29	        branch: str,
30	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
31	        ...
32	
33	
34	class SyncEngine:
35	    def __init__(
36	        self,
37	        config,
38	        reader: SnapshotReader,
39	        git_client: GitSyncClient,
40	        renderer: Callable[[ThingsSnapshot], RenderedSnapshot] = render_snapshot,
41	        reconciler: Callable[[Path, RenderedSnapshot], ChangeSet] = reconcile,
42	    ) -> None:
43	        self.config = config
44	        self.reader = reader
45	        self.git_client = git_client
46	        self.renderer = renderer
47	        self.reconciler = reconciler
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	    def _sync_locked(self, status) -> SyncResult:
51	        status["stage"] = "reader"
52	        snapshot = self.reader.read_snapshot()
53	        status["stage"] = "renderer"
54	        rendered = self.renderer(snapshot)
55	        status["stage"] = "reconciler"
56	        changes = self.reconciler(self.config.repo_path, rendered)
57	        status["changes"] = changes
58	        status["stage"] = "git"
59	        committed, pushed = self.git_client.sync(
60	            changes,
61	            auto_commit=self.config.auto_commit,
62	            auto_push=self.config.auto_push,
63	            remote=self.config.git_remote,
64	            branch=self.config.git_branch,
65	        )
66	        status["committed"] = committed
67	        status["pushed"] = pushed
68	        return SyncResult(changes, committed, pushed)
69	
70	    @staticmethod
71	    def _log_sync(started, status) -> None:
72	        try:
73	            changes = status["changes"]
74	            counts = (
75	                (len(changes.added), len(changes.modified), len(changes.deleted))
76	                if changes is not None
77	                else ("unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable")
78	            )
79	            committed = status["committed"]
80	            pushed = status["pushed"]
81	            if committed is None:
82	                committed = "not executed"
83	            if pushed is None:
84	                pushed = "not executed"
85	            duration = time.monotonic() - started
86	            error = status["error"]
87	            if error is None:
88	                _LOG.info(
89	                    "sync succeeded duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s",
90	                    duration,
91	                    counts[0],
92	                    counts[1],
93	                    counts[2],
94	                    committed,
95	                    pushed,
96	                )
97	            else:
98	                _LOG.error(
99	                    "sync failed stage=%s duration=%.3fs added=%s modified=%s deleted=%s committed=%s pushed=%s error=present",
100	                    status["stage"],
101	                    duration,
102	                    counts[0],
103	                    counts[1],
104	                    counts[2],
105	                    committed,
106	                    pushed,
107	                )
108	        except BaseException:
109	            # Logging must never hide a pipeline exception or prevent unlock.
110	            pass
111	
112	    def _run_locked(self, started) -> SyncResult:
113	        status = {
114	            "stage": "reader",
115	            "changes": None,
116	            "committed": None,
117	            "pushed": None,
118	            "error": None,
119	        }
120	        try:
121	            return self._sync_locked(status)
122	        except BaseException as error:
123	            status["error"] = error
124	            raise
125	        finally:
126	            try:
127	                self._log_sync(started, status)
128	            finally:
129	                self._lock.release()
130	
131	    def sync(self) -> SyncResult:
132	        started = time.monotonic()
133	        self._lock.acquire()
134	        return self._run_locked(started)
135	
136	    def sync_if_idle(self) -> bool:
137	        started = time.monotonic()
138	        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
139	            return False
140	        self._run_locked(started)
141	        return True
142	
```

199	class ThingsReader:
200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
201	
202	    def __init__(
203	        self,
204	        api: ThingsAPI,
205	        database_path: Path,
206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
207	        attempts: int = 3,
208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
209	    ) -> None:
210	        self.api = api
211	        self.database_path = database_path
212	        self.sleep = sleep
213	        self.attempts = attempts
214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
215	
216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
218	            try:
219	                return self._read_once()
220	            except Exception:
221	                logger.exception(
222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
223	                    attempt,
224	                    self.attempts,
225	                )
226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
227	                    raise
228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
230	
231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
235	            rows = _rows(
236	                self.api.todos(
237	                    status=status,
238	                    trashed=False,
239	                    context_trashed=False,
240	                    include_items=True,
241	                    filepath=filepath,
242	                )
243	            )
244	            for row in rows:
245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
246	                    continue
247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
248	                if not uuid:
249	                    continue
250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
254	
255	        projects = []
256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
259	
260	        areas = []
261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
264	
265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
267	
268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
270	            projects=tuple(projects),
271	            areas=tuple(areas),
272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
274	        )

41	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
42	    value = match.group(0)
43	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
44	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
45	        return value
46	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
47	    if not userinfo:
48	        return value
49	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))

52	def _redact_credentials(text: str) -> str:
53	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
54	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
55	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

179	            if diff.returncode != 1:
180	                return False
181	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
182	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
183	                return False
184	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
185	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
186	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
187	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
188	                return False
189	        finally:
190	            try:
191	                index_path.unlink()
192	            except FileNotFoundError:
193	                pass
194	
195	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
196	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
197	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
198	            return False
199	        self._commit_state = _COMMIT_SUCCESS
200	        return True
201	
202	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
203	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
204	        del changes
205	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
206	
207	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
208	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
209	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
210	
211	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
212	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
213	        if result is None:
214	            return False
215	        if result.returncode == 0:
216	            return True
217	        if result.returncode != 1:
218	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
219	        return False
220	
221	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
222	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
223	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
224	
225	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
226	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
227	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
228	
229	    def sync(
230	        self,
231	        changes: ChangeSet,
232	        auto_commit: bool,
233	        auto_push: bool,
234	        remote: str,
235	        branch: str,
236	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
237	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
238	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
239	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
240	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
241	        if not auto_commit:
242	            return (False, False)
243	
244	        paths = changes.git_paths
245	        committed = False
246	        pending = False
247	        if paths:
248	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
249	            if self._commit_state == _COMMIT_FAILURE:
250	                return (False, False)
251	            if committed:
252	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
253	                    return (False, False)
254	                pending = True
255	        if not pending and auto_push:
256	            pending = self.pending_push()
257	        if not auto_push or not pending:
258	            return (committed, False)
259	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
260	            return (committed, False)
261	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
262	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
263	            return (committed, False)
264	        return (committed, True)
265

38	        if not path:

67	class DebouncedSync:
68	    """Run a sync after a quiet period and coalesce notifications while it runs."""
69	
70	    def __init__(
71	        self,
72	        request: Callable[[], bool],
73	        delay: float,
74	        timer_factory=threading.Timer,
75	    ) -> None:
76	        if delay <= 0:
77	            raise ValueError("delay must be positive")
78	        self._request = request
79	        self._delay = delay
80	        self._timer_factory = timer_factory
81	        self._condition = threading.Condition()
82	        self._timer = None
83	        self._running = False
84	        self._pending = False
85	        self._stopped = False
86	        self._generation = 0
87	        self._callback_thread = None
88	
89	    def start(self) -> None:
90	        """Keep the debouncer active; provided for lifecycle symmetry."""
91	        with self._condition:
92	            if self._stopped:
93	                return
94	
95	    def _schedule_locked(self) -> None:
96	        self._generation += 1
97	        generation = self._generation
98	        timer = self._timer_factory(self._delay, lambda: self._fire(generation))
99	        timer.daemon = True
100	        self._timer = timer
101	        timer.start()
102	
103	    def notify(self) -> None:
104	        with self._condition:
105	            if self._stopped:
106	                return
107	            self._pending = True
108	            if not self._running:
109	                if self._timer is not None:
110	                    self._timer.cancel()
111	                self._schedule_locked()
112	
113	    def _fire(self, generation: int) -> None:
114	        with self._condition:
115	            if self._stopped or generation != self._generation:
116	                return
117	            self._timer = None
118	            self._pending = False
119	            self._running = True
120	            self._callback_thread = threading.current_thread()
121	
122	        retry = False
123	        try:
124	            retry = not bool(self._request())
125	        except Exception:
126	            _LOG.exception("Debounced sync request failed")
127	        finally:
128	            with self._condition:
129	                self._running = False
130	                self._callback_thread = None
131	                if not self._stopped and (self._pending or retry):
132	                    self._pending = False
133	                    self._schedule_locked()
134	                self._condition.notify_all()
135	
136	    def stop(self, wait: bool = True) -> None:
137	        with self._condition:
138	            if self._stopped:
139	                running = self._running
140	            else:
141	                self._stopped = True
142	                self._pending = False
143	                self._generation += 1
144	                timer = self._timer
145	                self._timer = None
146	                if timer is not None:
147	                    timer.cancel()
148	                running = self._running
149	
150	        if wait and running and threading.current_thread() is not self._callback_thread:
151	            with self._condition:
152	                while self._running:
153	                    self._condition.wait()

157	    """Own a non-recursive watchdog observer for one database directory."""
158	
159	    def __init__(
160	        self,
161	        database_path: Path,

163	        observer_factory=Observer,
164	    ) -> None:
165	        self._database_path = Path(database_path)
166	        self._debounce = debounce
167	        self._observer_factory = observer_factory
168	        self._observer = None
169	        self._started = False

172	        if self._started:
173	            return
174	        parent = self._database_path.parent
175	        if not parent.is_dir():
176	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database directory not found: {parent}")
177	        observer = self._observer_factory()
178	        handler = DatabaseEventFilter(self._database_path, self._debounce.notify)
179	        observer.schedule(handler, str(parent), recursive=False)
180	        try:

182	        except Exception:
183	            self._observer = None
184	            try:

186	            except Exception:

188	            try:

190	            except Exception:

192	            raise

200	        self._started = False
201	        self._observer = None
202	        observer.stop()
